jobs.title: Control Room Operator
jobs.description: Reference EPR009470 Posting Reference Location Houston, TX, USA Type Full Time Job Category Operations This position will function as part of EthosEnergy’s Performance Center, a 24x7 operation, which provides remote monitoring and operational support to power generation, renewable energy, and battery storage facilities using advanced pattern recognition (APR) and thermal modeling software to help improve customer outcomes. Responsible for providing advanced condition monitoring and data analyses of critical plant systems and components, then interfacing with plant personnel and internal subject matter experts to diagnose and develop actions for plant and equipment\-related problems. Will have day\-to\-day responsibility for monitoring and interpreting the alerts produced by software models and tools. Provide the first line of communication with the plant staff when a confirmed anomaly is detected by the center. The role will also operate select power plants throughout a variety of operational scenarios from cold plant startup to emergency operations during plant upsets. This aspect of the position will require excellent troubleshooting, diagnosis and decision making and leadership skills. This position will require working experience with the use of Distributive Control System (DCS) or SCADA computers to operate plant equipment and for monitoring of equipment to measure, record and make adjustments within operating parameters. Will also include dispatching remote personnel as needs arise which require site presence. The position will assist in the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and provide input to plant improvement items to improve plant efficiency, reliability, regulatory compliance, and safety. Incumbent should have a good working knowledge of PC computers using Microsoft Office products. Ensures compliance with all local, State and Federal regulations and plant procedures. #### **Job Responsibilities** * Remote Monitoring * Establish protocols for communication between plant staff and center staff. * Willingness to work rotating shift which includes nights, weekends and holiday coverage. * Develop, maintain, and use advanced pattern recognition (APR) software models and plant operational data to detect changes in the operating behavior of plant equipment and systems. * Perform daily monitoring of site critical components that have installed models actively collecting data using advanced analytics software. Respond, evaluate, and prioritize alarms for potential equipment related issues and interact with station personnel and provide recommendations to optimize plant equipment and systems. * Support and interface with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to assess equipment anomalies. * Communicate equipment anomalies to plant operations and engineering personnel and plant technical analysts. * Identify and classify associated risks to the plant, provide recommendations to mitigate risks, and follow up to ensure resolutions are tracked through to completion. * Monitor equipment performance and predict component health, alerting corporate SME’s and station personnel of anomalies within those trends which could adversely affect the reliability, availability, maintainability and performance of equipment. * Support the implementation of thermal performance software models for the generation fleet. * Work with power plant staff to troubleshoot and resolve operational problems identified by the thermal performance software models. * Master all aspects of the monitoring and diagnostic center software tools including, but not limited to, APR and thermal performance monitoring. * Update, retrain, and evaluate the adequacy of existing APR and thermal performance software models. * Capture and quantify customer benefits to express to ensure delivered value. * Safety: Maintain safety awareness and comply with all safety policies, practices, and procedures to assure a safe working environment. Remote Operations * Operate commercial power generation, renewable energy and battery storage facilities remotely. * Regularly makes decisions on non\-routine or escalated technical issues. * Ability to use multiple data sources such as SCADA, plant controls, and data historians to troubleshoot problems with sites and site equipment * Independently prioritizes and executes responsibilities effectively for a single trade, group of related tasks or functional area. * Checks own work and possibly the work of others; work results are of the highest quality standards and advanced technical competency. * Resolving the most complex technical issues, conferring with leadership occasionally; may serve as resource to others in resolution of complex issues. * Works under limited supervision. Results oriented self\-starter that can work independently * Prioritizes schedule and may guide others in the completion of tasks within clearly defined schedules as set by management. * Regularly provides on\-the\-job skills training to o nderstanding of electrical theory * Experience in organizing and managing multiple projects. * Proven ability to plan and ability to discern problems that need immediate attention versus those that allow more time to resolve. * Proved ability to adapt to changing priorities. * Awareness of and compliance with NERC/CIP requirements applicable to facility and remote operations. * Must be able to make timely decisions, apply seasoned judgment, and display personal responsibility. * Display unquestionable trust, superior performance, and total commitment. * Be a team player \- able to quickly build good working relationships #### **Required Skills / Knowledge** * Good understanding of power plant performance (thermal, physical, operational, and environmental) including factors that impact performance. * Able to recognize off normal conditions and trends in critical equipment parameters. * Superior interpersonal and communication skills necessary to develop relationships with the customer, other Plant Support personnel, and Plant Operations personnel which promote an atmosphere of mutual trust and respect. * Strong working knowledge of rotating components such as pumps, motors, steam turbines, gas turbines, generators and field instrumentation. * Familiarity with Condition Based Maintenance programs and technology applications * Effective English communication and technical report writing skills are required. * Must be proficient with various software programs and systems (e.g., MS Outlook , Word, Excel, PowerPoint) as well as database use. * Must be able to work independently with little supervision, perform in a team environment, as well as effectively communicate with others #### **Experience** * Candidate needs to have six (6\) to ten (10\) years' experience in drum type, supercritical, and/or CCGT fossil fueled power plants as a Generation/Plant Engineer, Lead Operator, Maintenance Technician or Condition Based Maintenance (CBM) Specialist. Experience and knowledge in all aspects of power plant systems and operations. #### **Education Requirements** * High School Diploma, Desired\-Bachelor of Science in Engineering, or an equivalent combination of experience and/or education. Associates degree of Applied Science from technical/vocational school, military service or equivalent. Desired Qualifications * Experience in developing, implementing and operating performance monitoring programs is highly desired. * Experience with Advanced Pattern Recognition and/or diagnostic tools. * GE, Siemens or other OEM combustion turbine and steam turbine engineering or operating experience. * Experience with power plant controls and control logic. * Experience with vibration analysis of rotating equipment. * Experience with lubrication analysis of rotating equipment. * Analytical skills to provide decision making support to the plants regarding suggested improvements in equipment and unit operations and for identification of instrumentation issues. * Working knowledge of Advanced Pattern Recognition (APR) and thermal performance software or other reliability or condition based predictive diagnosis software applications. #### **Physical Requirements** * Ability to do walking, reaching, climbing, and stooping and lifting (up to 50 pounds). * Comfortable working rotating shift schedule #### **What We Offer** * Supportive company culture that values its employees * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision \& 401 K Plan * Paid Parental Leave, Time Off \& Holidays * Extra money in your paycheck \- Employee Referral Bonus * Personal Development \& Career Succession Planning * Company sponsored Perks \& Discount programs EthosEnergy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.description: ### **Description** Creativity. Innovation. A desire to effect positive change. Quality of life is also important on the job, so we’ve prioritized work\-life balance by offering flexible/remote work opportunities, part\-time benefits, and generous PTO. We believe that each day is an opportunity to support one another, to support our clients, and to support our communities. If you feel the same, then you’ve found your future. We are seeking a detail\-oriented Water Resources Engineer to join our growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for an early\-career professional to develop practical expertise in water resources engineering while working under the mentorship of experienced senior staff. design, thermal\-fluid system design, piping system fluid flow analysis, and heat transfer analysis. * Learn the operations of existing accelerator fluids systems and provide operations engineering vendors, contractors, and fabricators through written specifications and engineering drawings. **Minimum Required Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s in an applicable Engineering discipline from have strong computing skills including preparing and documenting engineering calculations, creating 3D models and 2D drawings using CAD software, FEA analyses, data presentation, and project management activities (cost estimates, schedules). * Skills in AFT Fathom, AFT Arrow, ANSYS Workbench, ANSYS Fluent, or ANSYS CFX are desirable. * Ability to create and read mechanical drawings, including piping and instrumentation diagrams (P\&ID) and process piping flow schematics. * Familiarity of CAD software toward the creation of piping fluid flow network systems is a plus. * Skills in AutoCAD Plant are desirable. * Use of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing on drawings is desirable. * Demonstrated ability to creatively solve engineering problems and troubleshoot operational issues. * Knowledge of materials, metallurgy and radiation damage of materials is desirable. * Knowledge of code standards such as ASME, AISC and ANSI/ASME pressure vessel and piping codes is desirable. * Basic understanding of electrical engineering concepts such as current, voltages, resistance, and frequencies. **Physical Activity and Work Conditions:** * HUMAN FACTORS: Heights, working in underground enclosures, mental concentration, sitting, standing, tight work schedule, visually demanding. **Work Arrangement:** Please note that the described work arrangement is subject to change based on business needs and is not guaranteed to be final. * **Onsite:** This is an onsite role, and the candidate must be able to work from our Batavia Office. **Benefits/Perks:** * Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Accounts * Paid time off * Life insurance * Short and Long\-term disability insurance * Retirement benefits * Onsite day care **Why Fermilab:** Fermilab is America’s premier laboratory for particle physics and accelerator research, funded by the U.S. Department of Energy. We support discovery science experiments in Illinois and locations around the world, including deep underground mines in South Dakota and Canada, mountaintops in Arizona and Chile, CERN in Europe and the South Pole. **Pre\-Employment Screening:** **Drug\-Free Workplace \& Pre\-Employment Screening** Fermilab is dedicated to fostering a safe, productive and drug\-free environment. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: US \- Remote Data Remote Full\-time ### **Company Overview** Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health. Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action. Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent. We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future. ### **Role** At Function, the person who best understands a piece of data is rarely the person who can safely change it. A data scientist knows exactly how a biomarker should be derived. A clinician knows which reference range is wrong. Today, both have to file a ticket and wait for an engineer. We think that's a platform failure, not a process problem. Our job is to build the paved road that lets the subject matter expert make the change themselves – and lets an agent make it too – without anyone lying awake wondering about the validity or stability of what just shipped. That means the guardrails have to be real: declarative contracts instead of hand\-rolled code, CI that diffs the *data* and not just the diff, validations that gate promotion, lineage that tells you who's downstream, and a rollback that takes one command. Get that right and both your humans and your agents get faster at the same time, for the same reason. That's the work. It's platform engineering, and the users are engineers. ### **Key Responsibilities** Three surfaces, all with the same goal – make the safe path the fast path: * **Tracking infrastructure.** The event pipeline behind product analytics, experimentation, and feature gates. Schemas that are enforced at the source, so a bad event never becomes a bad metric. * **Data processing infrastructure.** The Bronze Silver Gold layer in Databricks. Automated schema evolution, contract tests, backfills that aren't scary, freshness and volume monitors generated from the contract rather than bolted on after. * **ML infrastructure.** Feature computation and serving, training and eval pipelines, and the plumbing that gets model output back into the product — with the same testing and observability bar as everything else. * **Cutting across all three.** The self\-service story. Templates, local dev and preview environments, policy\-as\-code for PHI, ownership routing for alerts, and progressive gates so an exploratory model ships freely while a member\-facing one earns more scrutiny. ### **Qualifications/Skills** * Built internal platform or infrastructure that other engineers actually adopted. You've felt the difference between shipping a tool and getting it used. * Operated production data or ML systems, on call for them, and fixed them under pressure. * Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable in a lakehouse – we use Databricks; Snowflake or BigQuery translates fine. * Designed interfaces and schemas that other teams depend on, then evolved them without breaking those teams. * Thought hard about testing and CI for data or ML, where correctness is statistical and the failure is often silent. * 1\-4 years of engineering experience gets you here, but we care about what you've built, not the number. ### **Nice\-to\-Have Skills and Experiences** While the core competencies are essential, the following qualifications will distinguish exceptional candidates: * Declarative pipeline frameworks (dbt, DLT, Dagster, Airflow) * Streaming (Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming) * Data contracts, data diffing, or lineage tooling * Terraform * Feature stores * MLOps and eval jobs.description: ### **Description** Gonzalez Companies is a partner\-managed engineering firm providing planning, design, and construction management services to water and wastewater utilities, transportation agencies, municipalities, and public\-sector clients. We are seeking a talented **Design Engineer** to join our growing team and help deliver impactful infrastructure projects that improve the communities we serve. This opportunity is ideal for an engineer with **3 to 10 years of experience** who is looking to expand their technical expertise, take on additional project responsibilities, and contribute to meaningful civil infrastructure projects. You will work alongside experienced engineering professionals while gaining exposure to project design, client service, and project delivery. Candidates with experience in **site/civil engineering, transportation, water/wastewater, or utility infrastructure** are encouraged to apply.### **Your Primary Responsibilities will include:** * Develop engineering designs, plans, specifications, and construction documents for infrastructure, site development, water/wastewater, and transportation projects. * Perform engineering analyses, calculations, and modeling to support design decisions, including grading and drainage design, hydraulic modeling, and utility design. * Prepare construction drawings and technical documents using AutoCAD Civil 3D and other engineering software. * Coordinate with multidisciplinary project teams, including civil, structural, environmental, mechanical, and electrical professionals. * Ensure designs comply with applicable local, state, and federal regulations, codes, and industry standards. * Assist with technical reports, engineering studies, permit applications, and supporting documentation. * Support project managers with project planning, scope development, scheduling, budgeting, and project tracking. * Conduct field investigations, site visits, and data collection to support project development and validate existing conditions. * Collaborate with clients, contractors, and regulatory agencies to address technical questions and resolve project challenges. * Review shop drawings, RFIs, and contractor submittals to ensure conformance with design intent during construction. * Identify innovative, sustainable, and cost\-effective engineering solutions that add value to our clients. * Maintain accurate project records and follow established quality control standards and procedures. ### **What you'll need:** * Bachelor's degree in **Civil Engineering** or a related engineering discipline. * **3 to 10 years of engineering design experience** in civil infrastructure, transportation, site development, or water/wastewater projects. * Engineer\-in\-Training (**EIT**) certification required. * Professional Engineer (**PE**) license, or the ability to obtain licensure, preferred. * Proficiency with engineering design software, including **AutoCAD Civil 3D** and other applicable analysis or modeling tools. * Working knowledge of applicable engineering codes, regulations, and industry standards. * Strong technical, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet project deadlines in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Experience preparing construction documents, technical specifications, and permit\-related documentation. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook. * Willingness and ability to perform periodic field work, site visits, and inspections as required. ### **Gonzalez Offers Competitive Benefits including:** * Competitive salary * Major medical, dental and vision insurance * Flexible Spending Account * Health Savings Account * 401K * Bonus program * Paid holidays and generous paid time off * Professional development * A team of creative and talented individuals to work alongside Gonzalez is a rapidly growing, dynamic, professional services firm specializing in civil engineering, construction management, and construction inspection. Our clientele includes large and small water, sewer, and utility districts; departments of transportation and other public transportation agencies; and municipalities throughout the Midwest. Working primarily in the Greater St. Louis, Chicago, and Louisville metro areas, Gonzalez offers a great work environment, generous benefit packages, and opportunities to succeed in many professional disciplines. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Gonzalez Companies, LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. \#LI\-KC2### **About Gonzalez Companies** Gonzalez Companies partners with private and public sector clients. Since 2004, Gonzalez Companies has served clients primarily throughout the Midwest, with 8 offices in 5 different states. We know the importance of providing accessibility to clients. Gonzalez Companies is a partner managed firm that provides comprehensive Planning, Design, and Construction Management Services to large and small Water, Sewer and Utility Districts; Departments of Transportation; and municipalities.

jobs.title: Compliance Operations Program Manager, Risk, Compliance and Integrity
jobs.description: This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus. Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include: * Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; Washington D.C., DC, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 3 years of experience in program or project management. * 2 years of experience working with data analytics tools and reporting platforms. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Program Management certification or experience in program management with a technology company. * 3 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects. * Experience operating in a compliance, regulatory, or risk management environment. * Experience in stakeholder management. * Demonstrated ability to adapt to novel technologies to solve data and process problems, particularly in the legal/compliance space. **About the job** ----------------- The Risk, Compliance and Integrity (RCI) Process Transformation team operates at the critical intersection of regulatory compliance and technological innovation. In an era defined by rapid AI expansion and complex global regulations, our team is tasked with transforming Google’s compliance operations from a manual, human\-heavy process to a highly scalable, AI\-first model. We act as the tip of the spear for the regulatory lifecycle ingesting and deconstructing new obligations so downstream product teams can innovate safely and quickly. Our mission is to maintain the highest standard of risk mitigation in our day\-to\-day operations while pushing the boundaries of automation, AI integration, and process design. As a Compliance Operations Program Manager, you will serve as the agile, operational partner to our executive technical leadership during a pivotal transformation within the Risk, Compliance and Integrity (RCI) organization. You will actively balance the immediate needs of running our core compliance operations with the strategic imperative to test, evaluate, and implement next\-generation automated tooling. Operating as a flexible, tech\-curious problem solver, you will bridge the gap between day\-to\-day execution and future\-state automation. While you don't need to be a software engineer, your technical intuition, creativity with data, and ability to translate complex workflows into scalable processes will directly accelerate Google's transition toward an AI\-driven regulatory compliance model. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $111000 \- $159000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Partner directly with senior leads to actively balancing daily core compliance operations with the rapid development of newly automated solutions. * Execute day\-to\-day programmatic tracking of end\-to\-end compliance processes, ensuring timely project delivery and proactively identifying operational risks across the portfolio. * Evaluate, test and validate emerging technical tooling, actively assisting the organization in transitioning from manual compliance mapping to highly scalable, AI\-driven processes. * Translate complex regulatory and compliance requirements into structured data formats to directly support downstream engineering and automation initiatives. * Develop creative, agile operational solutions using internal business intelligence tools to unblock process bottlenecks and continuously improve overall workflow velocity. Engage in continuous process improvement, navigating ambiguous situations and adapting to changing business contexts to deliver high\-quality outcomes. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Data Center Technician II, Global Server Operations
jobs.description: This role is not eligible for U.S. immigration sponsorship.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Experience with performing component\-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment. * Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols. * Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting. * Must have the ability to work non\-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift\-based schedules as required. * Must be available to travel to support business priorities as operationally required. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * Completion of the online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program. * 2 years of experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols. * Experience with performing component\-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g., Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc.). * Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment. * Ability to collaborate and partner with teams to overcome challenges, and to adapt to changes in a dynamic work environment. **About the job** ----------------- Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state\-of\-the\-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting\-edge of computer technology. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $86000 \- $118000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or functions. * Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose straightforward issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and applying the resources needed to resolve identified issues. * Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards. * Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end\-of\-life via part replacement or maintenance, in a team setting. * Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with defined solutions and limited guidance. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or IT\-related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3 years of experience with IT operations, Linux administration, and scripting. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 3 years of experience with Linux operating systems internals and administration. * 3 years of experience in IT infrastructure management, in an emulation lab or high\-performance computing environment. * 3 years of experience with Cloud systems design. * 3 years of experience with one or more programming/scripting languages (Python, Bash). **About the job** ----------------- Systems Development Engineering (SDE) at Google is a role where you manage services and systems at scale. SDEs creatively put their engineering discipline to use automating the mundane and reducing toil. We don’t just write code to fix bugs, but emphasize the development of tools and solutions that fix classes of problems. We know it’s hard to control what you can’t measure – so we focus on observability: instrumenting first, then turning data into knowledge, and finally knowledge into action. We know that the operational efficiency of Google systems, services, virtual compute environments and the operating systems that power them impact the environment, not just the bottom line. We know that working together we can do more, and that community matters. Google brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame\-free environment. We promote self\-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. Together we engineer and build the infrastructure, tools, access and telemetry for systems that enable orchestration of Google\-scale services. Come build things that matter. As a Systems Development Engineer, you will help maintain and improve existing systems, while helping develop next\-generation solutions for future projects. You will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and optimal performance of our emulation lab. This involves managing and maintaining the lab's IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, networking, and security systems. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 6 years of experience working with client\-side web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or HTTP). * 6 years of experience coding with one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, C/C\+\+, Python). * Experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. * Experience in an investigative role such as business intelligence, data analytics, or statistics. * Experience working with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL). * Experience with cloud technologies such as architecting, developing, or maintaining cloud solutions in virtualized environments, or cloud data engineering. * Experience using Machine Learning and building solutions. * Experience working with systems (e.g., Linux, Unix, Windows). **About the job** ----------------- In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more). At gTech’s Users and Products team (gUP), our mission is to help users get the most out of Google. We represent Google's users and many of our partners globally, sharing insights with the larger Google organization to enable exceptional customer and product experiences. The Chrome Partner Engineering team is part of the gTech Web and Search Ecosystems team supporting Chrome's goal of a healthy, vibrant web in this increasingly agentic world. We're a group of technical experts addressing key programs that advance Chrome's goals. By working with partners and developers, we aim to arm the ecosystem with the tools, incentives, and products they need to succeed in the future of the web ecosystem. In this role, you won't just support product areas like Built\-in AI, Agentic Web, Identity and Payments, Browser Fundamentals, and Growth—you will also influence the trajectory of the entire web ecosystem. Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products. To learn more about gTech, check out our video. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $152000 \- $221000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Act as a trusted technical Strategist to the Partner Engineers in the Chrome and Web gTech team, supporting their engineering and product efforts as they plan their digital strategy, with clear implementation plans as it pertains to the web. * Identify and define future platform capabilities by understanding partner or product needs, translating them into actionable product proposals, with the goal of validating the next generation of web technologies. * Generate the foundational proof points or activation strategies for GTM that are essential for market assessment, incubation, and broad adoption, while focusing on high\-leverage ways to achieve these goals. * Provide a high\-fidelity, actionable feedback channel from partner engineers directly into the product development lifecycle. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3 years of experience working with client\-side web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or HTTP). * 3 years of experience coding with one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, C/C\+\+, Python). * Experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers. * Experience using AI for workflows. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 5 years of experience in technical troubleshooting. * 3 years of experience in data analysis using SQL/MySQL. * 3 years of experience in the Payments industry. * Experience working with and managing external partners or customers. * Strong program management skills with experience coordinating cross\-functional teams. * Excellent communication (written and verbal), people management, and stakeholder management skills. **About the job** ----------------- In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more). In this role, you will help businesses around the world deliver seamless and secure digital payment experiences while collaborating closely with internal cross\-functional teams. You will spend your days supporting external partners as they adopt our solutions, troubleshooting web and mobile checkout flows. As the primary technical bridge to our partners, you will identify friction points and shape future platform enhancements. Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products. To learn more about gTech, check out our video. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $127000 \- $182000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Maintain Google Pay developer documentation, integration playbooks, and partner resources, while managing and triaging technical issues submitted by developers and partners. * Act as a trusted technical advisor for merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), and e\-commerce platforms, guiding them through the architectural design and end\-to\-end implementation of Google Pay across web and mobile surfaces. * Diagnose and resolve complex integration and transactional issues, collaborating closely with external engineering teams to ensure optimal checkout reliability, performance, and security. * Gather real\-world partner insights and technical feedback to advocate for platform enhancements, translating integration issues into actionable requirements for internal Google Product and Engineering teams. * Create and maintain reference implementations, code samples, testing guides, and integration tools that streamline onboarding and make adopting Google Pay fast and frictionless for developers. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Developer Platform, Google Search
jobs.description: In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include: * Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; New York, NY, USA; Seattle, WA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role. * 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc). * 1 year of experience building and delivering AI products and agentic development solutions (e.g., autonomous coding agents, AI\-assisted developer tools, or equivalent) for software engineering. * 1 year of experience with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., generative AI coding assistants or equivalent platforms). * Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in a technology or business related field. * 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership. * 2 years of experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders. * Experience driving AI\-transformation initiatives at your workplace. * Experience with the software development lifecycle, tooling, and workflows. **About the job** ----------------- At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. As a Product Manager on the Search AI Developer Tools Platform (ADP) team, you will be at the forefront of the generative AI revolution at Google. Your mission will be to build and deliver cutting\-edge agentic development solutions and AI\-assisted developer tools that transform how software engineering is done. You will shape the future of knowledge discovery and development workflows, empowering engineers to build faster and smarter. By leveraging Google's exceptional Search and AI capabilities, you will drive AI\-transformation initiatives that have a profound impact on the software development lifecycle and usher in the next generation of developer productivity. In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $163000 \- $236000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Work with partner teams (e.g., engineers, PgMs, UX) during product design and development to translate PRDs into actionable OKRs for the AI Developer Tools Platform. * Define product roadmaps and operationalize strategy for new agentic development solutions. * Develop and secure buy\-in for a compelling product goal that drives the adoption of AI\-assisted tools and supports the overall product narrative. * Validate the market size and user\-based strategic opportunities for new AI developer platform features. * Drive the end\-to\-end launch, maintenance, and iteration of developer\-facing AI products in collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. **Step Into the Multiverse: Your Next Adventure Starts Here** At **Wizards of the Coast**, we harness the power of imagination and connection to create unforgettable experiences. We create entertainment that inspires creativity, sparks passion, forges friendships, and fosters communities around the globe. In every pursuit our mission is to inspire a lifetime love of games. The Digital Innovations Team (DigIT) is changing how Wizards develops, delivers, and manages the digital systems behind our games — for players, retailers, and the studios that develop our worlds. We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer who can guide product ideas through every stage with agentic AI — from defining the problem with business partners, to developing the system, to deploying it in production, and then improving it based on actual data. This job is not for those who have only observed AI changes from a distance. We need a hands\-on creator. If your AI experience is primarily slides and architectural drawings, this is not the right role. **About the Role** You will be responsible for the technical direction of an initiative and the related product surface area, direct tech direction and product direction with/without PM support. You are answerable for what the team delivers, how quickly it adapts, and the business outcomes that result. You will build products using agentic AI as your default development approach, leveraging the harness engineering and guardrails the team has developed. You contribute to evolving these patterns alongside peers, but your primary focus is shipping product. You understand where the technology performs well versus where it only demos effectively. You have informed opinions based on production experience about evaluations, guardrails, cost, latency, determinism, and the engineering methods needed to deliver AI products responsibly at scale. **What You'll Do:** * Guide product concepts through the entire process with agentic AI. Starting from outlining the problem alongside product and business collaborators, moving to prototype development, to a data\-informed launch, and then refining based on actual usage data. Deliver production\-quality agent systems, analyses, prompts, and supporting services on your own. Ensure the feedback loop is as short as feasible. * Contribute to the department's agentic AI harness engineering alongside peers. Apply, stress\-test, and improve shared patterns — LLMs, agents, Skills, MCP, eval frameworks, guardrails — through real production use. Bring back what works and what doesn't from the field. * Raise the engineering bar on architecture, code review, test strategy, observability, evals, and incident quality. Treat engineering excellence as a baseline expectation, not an optional initiative. * Lead position, influence people and product decisions. Make your EM and PM more effective at their jobs. * Contribute to the hiring bar. Lead technical interviews, calibrate the AI\-capability signal in our hiring loop, and mentor the next layer of senior and staff engineers. **What You'll Bring:** * Direct experience creating agentic AI systems. You have developed, deployed, and improved agentic systems in real\-world settings, beyond demos or proofs of concept. You can describe the code you authored, the tests you designed, the prompt and tool usage changes you made, the cost and latency considerations you evaluated, the failure types you managed, and the metrics you used to choose the next release. Interviews will involve a hands\-on agentic AI task. * Over 10 years of full\-stack software engineering experience. At least 3 years in a Tech Lead, Staff, or Principal role responsible for guiding the technical direction of a team or program. * Product\-engineer approach. You transform product ideas into operational, monitored, live software. You are comfortable prioritizing alongside PM or direct Product direction on your own, making product tradeoffs on the fly, and relying on metrics to guide iteration. You do not need a fully\-detailed ticket to begin. * Deep proficiency across the stack. Modern JavaScript / TypeScript and at least one of Go, Python, or C\#. You write production code, not just review it. * Strong systems and infrastructure foundation. AWS at scale, containerization, GitLab/GitHub CI/CD, PostgreSQL and data modeling, REST / gRPC / GraphQL API development, test automation, and a real point of view on observability and reliability. * Architectural judgment. You can defend a build decision, change your mind when the evidence warrants it, and write the build doc that brings the rest of the team along. * Business and product literacy. You can sit with a creative director, a retail partner, or a finance collaborator and have a conversation that is not purely technical. You can articulate business impact and tradeoffs without losing technical rigor. * Outstanding communication and collaboration. You make engineers around you better. You raise standards without becoming a bottleneck. You handle disagreement directly and well. * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Computer Science, Information Technology, or comparable work experience. **Nice to Have:** * Experience leading or contributing to platform / horizontal services (search, notifications, identity, eventing, workflow, data platforms) consumed by multiple product teams. * Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM). * Experience with Kubernetes, Akamai, Terraform, or equivalent infrastructure\-as\-code tooling. * Experience operating in a tri\-lead (TL / EM / PM) or similar matrixed engineering model. * Foundational knowledge of Magic: The Gathering, Dungeons \& Dragons, or the tabletop gaming space. *Compensation and benefits may vary based on location and role.* At Wizards, we believe in the magic of diversity—great ideas come from unique perspectives. With more than 70 years of business and technical expertise in mining, energy, and infrastructure, our 10,000 colleagues in 150 countries tirelessly work toward bettering the industries in which we operate. With practical solutions that are safe, innovative and sustainable, we think globally while acting locally. Are you looking for an opportunity to join a diverse group of professionals who are committed to remaining exceptional? We look forward to hearing from you. CORE brings together the necessary elements of a project to achieve nameplate value and deliver peak asset performance. Key Responsibilities * As a member of the Commissioning Team, under the direction of the Commissioning Manager, ensure Commissioning is conducted in compliance with the Safety Management Plan and all relevant Commissioning plans and procedures. * Approval of Testing and Inspection documentation. * Participation in, and approval of, Factory Acceptance Tests. * Participation in, and approval of, Performance and Acceptance Plans and Tests. * Ensure timely and formal review of Electrical commissioning documentation and equipment at Mechanical Completion. * Expedite Management of Change (MOC) process to determine and action required modifications in a timely manner and minimize impact to commissioning activities. * Development and review of Commissioning Procedures. * Interface with the Construction Contractor’s Field Engineers to resolve issues at site. * Review of codes and specifications, test sheets, vendor installation and operation maintenance manuals. * Drive the delivery of the Completions Turnover process, from the Construction team to the Commissioning team, and from the Commissioning team to the Operations team through the CCMS Team, including:  Attendance to Completions Walkdowns as required  Review of turnover documentation, by facility, system, or sub\-system as appropriate  Punch lists and deficiency management  Review of Inspection and Testing Check Lists  Review of Test Reports. * Participate in daily meetings regarding Pre\-Commissioning and Commissioning activities and provide support as an active member of the Commissioning Team. * Other duties as required at the direction of the Commissioning Manager. Qualifications and Experience Essential * Relevant Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent experience. * Proficient with Microsoft Office components. * Experience in Commissioning with multidiscipline teams. * Commissioning Engineer must have at least 5 years specific experience in the supervision of specialized commissioning personnel on new electrical facilities. * A broad knowledge of installation, functional testing, and operation of Mechanical, Instrumentation, Piping and Electrical Systems utilized for various processes. jobs.title: Technology Designer
jobs.description: ### **Description** **HEAPY continues to grow**—and we're looking for a **Technology Designer** to join our team. This role is ideal for someone with experience designing integrated ICT systems, including structured cabling, networking, audio\-visual, security, and other building technologies. If you enjoy collaborating with architects, engineers, and clients to create innovative, connected environments, we'd love to hear from you. **Does this sound like you?** * Do you have experience designing integrated technology systems for commercial, healthcare, education, or other complex facilities? * Are you passionate about creating technology solutions that improve how buildings function and connect people? * Do you enjoy collaborating with engineers, architects, clients, and project teams to solve technical challenges? * Are you detail\-oriented while balancing multiple projects and deadlines? * Do you thrive in a collaborative, team\-focused environment where innovation, continuous learning, and exceptional client service are valued? If so, this is your opportunity to grow your career with a forward\-thinking company grounded in our **Colleague First Values.** Click Here to Learn More About HEAPY!### **Key Responsibilities** The Technology Designer supports the planning, design, and coordination of integrated technology systems for projects across multiple markets. This role works closely with clients, architects, engineers, and internal project teams to deliver high\-quality ICT solutions while contributing to HEAPY Solutions' collaborative, colleague\-first culture. **What You'll Do** * Design integrated technology systems including structured cabling, networking, audio\-visual, security, and other ICT infrastructure for a variety of building projects. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams to develop technology solutions that meet client goals, project requirements, and industry standards. * Prepare design documentation, specifications, calculations, and technical reports while supporting projects from concept through construction. * Perform field observations, review shop drawings and submittals, and help ensure successful project execution through quality\-focused design and coordination. ### **Physical Demands \& Work Environment** **QUALIFICATIONS** Normally requires a high school diploma along with a combination of education, experience, and technical knowledge related to integrated technology systems design in the built environment. **We're looking for someone who has:*** Experience designing integrated technology systems such as structured cabling, networking, audio\-visual, security, or other ICT systems. * Experience using industry\-standard design software and technology design tools. * Strong understanding of technology system design principles, documentation, and coordination within building projects. * Ability to prepare technical drawings, specifications, calculations, and supporting project documentation. * Strong communication and collaboration skills with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, and internal project teams. * Excellent organizational, problem\-solving, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. * A commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Pursuit of or attainment of **Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD)** certification is preferred. ### **Benefits** * **Built for People, Not Just Projects** – a collaborative, colleague\-first culture where you can do your best work * **Thrive with HEAPY Benefits** – premium medical, dental \& vision coverage designed with you in mind * **Invest in Your Future** – 401(k) with competitive contributions to help you plan ahead * **Be Rewarded for Your Impact** – 10–15% annual bonus potential tied to company performance and your contributions * **Own Your Time** – open PTO and paid sick time that gives you the flexibility to recharge when you need it * **Wellness Week** – we hit pause the final week of the year so you can rest, reset, and reflect * **Feel Your Best** – annual wellness benefit bonus focused on your overall well\-being * **Grow with Purpose** – annual professional development stipend to support your career goals \#LI\-TS1 \#LI\-Hybrid### **About HEAPY** Colleagues are at the center of everything we do at HEAPY. By engineering more sustainable, resilient buildings, our colleagues are creating healthy environments that inspire and have a positive impact on the community. In this way, HEAPY creates high\-performance buildings to help clients achieve not just their goals for form and function, but also around sustainability commitments, recruitment, retention, productivity, and occupant wellness. Our *Colleague First* approach encompasses how we invest in our colleagues here at HEAPY, as well as the way we engage with clients. Through active listening, creative collaboration, and support that extends throughout a building’s life cycle, we are creating a more rewarding engagement. Our national portfolio speaks to the HEAPY team’s MEP engineering, technology engineering, commissioning, and construction administration expertise. But what truly sets us apart is the belief that continually investing in our colleagues is good for our clients, our communities, and our company. HEAPY’s *Colleague First* culture reflects an environment in which people feel heard and respected, one where we take pride in delivering upon the core values of our organization. This support enables our colleagues to better guide clients through challenging design decisions and build the trust that enables unparalleled engineering solutions.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ================== As a Sales Engineer, you will operate as a lighter\-weight forward deployed engineer embedded in our go\-to\-market motion — part builder, part consultant. You will sit at the intersection of sales, product, and AI: writing code to prototype agentic demos, configuring use\-case\-specific agent flows, and then walking into the room to present them to clinical, commercial, and technical stakeholders. This is a role for an engineer who wants to be client\-facing — someone who can build with their hands and communicate with executive polish. You will partner with sales leadership on strategic pursuits across pharma and health systems, turning complex AI capabilities into demos and narratives that make prospects say "I need this." This role is based full\-time in our Menlo Park, CA office. **What You'll Do** ================== * Build and deliver tailored, high\-impact demos of our agentic AI platform — hands\-on prototyping of agent flows, scripts, and demo environments mapped to each prospect’s clinical and commercial workflows. * Write code where it moves deals forward: demo scaffolding, light integrations, data mocking, and rapid proofs of concept with LLM and agentic tooling. * Own the technical narrative in sales cycles — presentations, solution architectures, and ROI stories built alongside sales leadership. * Run discovery and scoping with prospects, translating requirements into agent and solution designs the way a consultant would structure an engagement. * Serve as the technical voice in the room — answering product, integration, and AI safety questions with credibility and clarity. * Support pilots and proofs of concept hands\-on, bridging the gap between what was sold and what gets deployed. * Feed field insights back to Product and ML teams to sharpen the platform and the pitch. **What You Bring** ================== **Must\-Have:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * 3–5 years of experience spanning software engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions/sales engineering, or technical consulting. * Ability to code — comfortable in Python or JavaScript, working with APIs, and prototyping with LLM\-based or agentic systems. * Consulting\-grade client presence: structured thinking, executive\-level presentations, and the ability to run a room. * Strong storytelling and communication skills; able to make complex technology simple for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Self\-starter who thrives in fast\-moving, ambiguous, high\-growth environments. * Commitment to safety, ethics, and patient\-centered outcomes. **Nice\-to\-Have:** * Forward deployed engineering, management consulting, or client\-embedded delivery experience. * Experience in healthcare, pharma, or life sciences technology. * Familiarity with conversational AI, voice agents, or agentic workflows. * Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders. **Why Join Hippocratic AI** --------------------------- **Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.** We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation. **Work with the people shaping the future.** Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA. **Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.** We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3\.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others. **Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.** Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. All recruiting communication will come from @******hippocraticai.com*** ***email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.***

We are seeking an experienced **Data Center Infrastructure Engineer** to provide hands\-on infrastructure support and execution for the Norman Engineering Lab. This role will support the deployment, migration, operation, troubleshooting, maintenance, and lifecycle management of compute, storage, networking, and supporting data center infrastructure used by global engineering and product teams. **Key Responsibilities** * Install, rack, cable, relocate, troubleshoot, repair, and decommission enterprise compute, storage, and network equipment. * Participate in hardware migrations, infrastructure deployments, lab expansions, and consolidation activities. * Execute approved implementation plans and infrastructure changes. * Troubleshoot server, storage, network, power, cabling, optics, firmware, and hardware connectivity issues. * Support console access, BMC, iLO, iDRAC, IPMI, firmware updates, hardware validation, and remote\-hands requests. * Install and maintain copper and fiber connectivity, rails, cable\-management components, and related rack infrastructure. * Validate rack space, power, connectivity, cabling, and deployment readiness before installation. * Maintain accurate rack elevations, asset records, serial numbers, equipment locations, and cabling documentation. * Create and update incidents, service requests, work items, and change records with accurate technical details. * Work with Network, Systems, Storage, Product Services, Engineering, Facilities, and global technical teams. * Support hardware staging, shipping, receiving, inventory, return, and disposal activities. * Follow established safety, security, change\-management, and operational procedures. * Identify discrepancies or risks and escalate before making changes. * Create and maintain implementation documentation, procedures, and runbooks. Participate in planned maintenance and occasional after\-hours activities as required. * **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of experience supporting enterprise data centers, engineering labs, infrastructure environments, or similar operations. * Strong hands\-on experience with enterprise compute, storage, networking, and physical data center infrastructure. * Experience supporting hardware migrations, infrastructure deployments, relocations, or consolidation activities. * Strong understanding of rack layouts, structured cabling, fiber optics, A/B power, PDUs, and equipment installation practices. * Experience troubleshooting hardware, network connectivity, storage connectivity, cabling, and related infrastructure issues. * Experience with enterprise Ethernet, Fibre Channel, and remote hardware\-management technologies. * Ability to interpret implementation plans, rack elevations, network diagrams, and technical documentation. * Experience with ticketing, change\-management, asset\-management, inventory, CMDB, or DCIM systems. * Ability to independently execute routine and moderately complex infrastructure work. * Strong documentation, organizational, and communication skills. * Ability to recognize operational risk and escalate appropriately. * Ability to safely install and move data center equipment. Ability to work onsite in Norman, Oklahoma. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Hitachi Vantara infrastructure technologies. * Experience with Cisco, Brocade, Dell, HPE, Lenovo, VMware, Red Hat, or comparable enterprise platforms. * Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server environments. * Experience with virtualization platforms. * Experience with DCIM, CMDB, monitoring, asset\-management, or capacity\-management systems. * Experience supporting engineering, development, quality\-assurance, high\-density compute, GPU, or AI environments. * Relevant infrastructure, networking, systems, virtualization, cloud, or data center certifications. Familiarity with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Ansible, APIs, or similar automation technologies a plus. * **Tools \& Platforms** * Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams. * Microsoft Visio or similar diagramming tools. * ITSM and work\-management platforms such as: + Jira Software + Jira Service Management + Confluence + ServiceNow Experience creating, updating, and closing incidents, service requests, work items, and change records. * As required by the equal pay and transparency acts, the expected base salary for this position is: $60K to $75K. The expected on\-target earnings for this position is: $65K to $82K The expected pay is determined based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, depth of experience in the practice area. Employees are eligible to participate in Hitachi Vantara’s bonus/variable/commission pay programs, where applicable, and are subject to the program’s conditions and restrictions. \#LI\-JT1 **About us** ============ We’re a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co\-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data\-driven leaders that can a make positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential. **Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives** ===================================================== Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth. We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work. **How we look after you** ========================= We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We’re also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We’re always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you’ll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with. We’re proud to say we’re an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.
