jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Minnesota \- Data Engineer #### **Hollstadt Overview** Hollstadt Consulting is a management and technology consulting firm dedicated to placing professionals at engagements where they will excel. When you work with us, you'll work with a refreshingly real company led and staffed by seasoned experts who are also down\-to\-earth, good people. We're committed to treating you with respect and helping you achieve your career aspirations. Since 1990, Hollstadt has been a trusted partner to more than 150 domestic and global companies and has successfully completed over 3,000 projects. Our continued growth has created challenging and rewarding opportunities for accomplished IT and Business Consultants. Hollstadt Consulting is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran. *By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI\-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Hollstadt Consulting and its affiliates, and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. You can reply STOP to cancel at any time.* **Job Description** **Role**: Data Engineer **Location**: Remote **Duration**: 6\-12 months (extension possible) **Rate**: $52\.51/hour W2 **1\. Engagement Overview** The client has selected **Globus** as a strategic Managed File Transfer (MFT) platform to address critical gaps in secure, large\-scale research data movement. The Globus platform is currently being installed in the **GCP Cloud Data DMZ** and is nearing completion of initial implementation. The Enterprise Interfaces team within the Enterprise Data organization has been designated as the **operational home** for Globus, alongside existing MFT solutions (Signiant and Cleo). The contractor will embed within the Enterprise Interfaces team and serve as the **primary technical resource** for completing Globus operationalization, onboarding initial research customers, establishing operational support processes, and building the team's institutional knowledge of the Globus ecosystem. This engagement is designed to bridge an immediate capacity gap while the organization plans for long\-term staffing through Phase 2 positions. **2\. Project Context** This engagement directly supports enterprise priorities including: * **Research Enablement** – Enabling secure, compliant, high\-throughput transfer of large research datasets (terabyte\- to petabyte\-scale) for Principal Investigator onboarding/offboarding, grant collaborations, and secure data downloads from approved external sites. * **MFT Consolidation** – Integrating Globus into the existing MFT portfolio alongside Signiant and Cleo, with a long\-term vision toward consolidated MFT operations with an AI\-operations\-centric approach. * **Security \& Compliance** – Ensuring alignment with internal ISA, BAA, TPRM, and NIST security framework requirements. **Key Architectural Elements:** * Globus SaaS control plane with user authentication via Entra ID (restricted to allowed identity providers) * Two internally hosted Compute Engine VMs running Globus Connect Server (GCS) v5 in the GCP Data DMZ * GCP ingress and egress S3 storage buckets with a defined 30\-day data lifecycle/retention rule * GridFTP parallel transfer protocol across HTTPS 443 and TCP ports 50000–51000 for high\-performance data movement * Globus Storage Gateways (Google S3 connectors) linking collections to GCP bucket storage * Data movement performed by Globus\-managed service accounts — no direct user access to underlying buckets * User provisioning managed via Sailpoint * Flat\-fee licensing model for unlimited data transfer and unlimited endpoints (cloud and on\-premises) **3\. Scope of Work / Key Responsibilities** The contractor will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following: **Platform Configuration \& Deployment Completion** * Complete final configuration and hardening of the Globus Connect Server (GCS v5\) deployment on GCP Compute Engine VMs within the Data DMZ * Configure and validate Globus Storage Gateways and S3 Storage Connectors for ingress and egress GCP buckets * Configure Globus collections (Managed and Guest) aligned with client's data access policies and identity provider restrictions * Validate end\-to\-end data transfer workflows including ingress, egress, and staging collection transfers across the Service Connector (SC) boundary into the MCC VPC * Configure DNS, authentication flows (OAuth/OpenID Connect via Entra ID), and endpoint registration within Globus.org **User Onboarding \& Research Customer Support** * Onboard initial research user groups to the Globus platform, providing hands\-on support for first transfers * Develop and document standardized user onboarding procedures, including Sailpoint provisioning workflows and Globus Web App access * Provide Tier 1/2 operational support for Globus users — troubleshooting transfer failures, stalled transfers, permission issues, connectivity ice\-to\-Have Skills** * Experience deploying Globus in a healthcare or regulated environment (HIPAA, NIST) * Familiarity with Azure DevOps (ADO) for config/state management and CI/CD pipelines * Experience with Terraform / Infrastructure as Code for GCP resource provisioning * Knowledge of Sailpoint or similar identity governance platforms for user provisioning * Experience with Entra ID (Azure AD) federation and SSO integration * Familiarity with High\-Performance Computing (HPC) environments and research data workflows * Experience with monitoring/observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, GCP Cloud Monitoring) * Understanding of Box.com integration patterns (Globus \+ Box complementary architecture) **6\. Other Requirements** * **Self\-directed problem solver** – Identifies issues, researches solutions, and proposes fixes without waiting for detailed instructions. Globus troubleshooting often requires deep dives into different layers of the stack (application, performance, networking, user\-support). * **Strong communicator** – Able to explain complex technical concepts to both technical staff and research customers; produces clear, concise documentation. * **Enables others** – Actively transfers knowledge to internal team members; creates operational runbooks and training materials that enable the team to assume full ownership. * **Customer\-oriented** – Comfortable working directly with research users to troubleshoot issues and guide them through data transfer workflows. * **Governance\-aware** – Navigates internal change management, approval processes, and security review requirements effectively. * **Proactive** – Anticipates operational needs, identifies process improvements, and proposes solutions for long\-term platform sustainability. **Required Education**: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering from an accredited University or College. * OR * Associate’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering from an accredited University or College with two (2\) years of experience. ### **Benefits \+ Perks** Comprehensive Benefit Plan Hollstadt offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, paid sick leave, and retirement benefits to eligible employees. With three different medical plans to choose from, you can enroll in the coverage you need from individual to family, or anywhere in between! Remarketing Process Hollstadt is based on retention and relationships. We get to know your strengths and career wishes throughout your assignment and then start remarket discussions 6\-8 weeks prior to your end date. By being proactive, we are able to keep your down time between assignments as short as possible, unless you choose otherwise. Professional Development Hollstadt offers on\-demand training through our consultant portal. Trainings give our consultants the continuing education they need to excel on their projects. Many of our courses apply towards continuing education credits and we have an entire training hub dedicated to upskilling in Artificial Intelligence (AI). 401k \+ Matching One popular benefit is our 401(k) match on the first 4% of your contributions. Hollstadt wants to help you reach your long\-term financial goals and understands that planning for your future is critical. Consultants also have access to support from a Financial Advisor. jobs.title: Quality Engineer (Entry level, Bilingual Mandarin)
jobs.description: Job Summary The Quality Engineer (QE) supports the development, implementation, and maintenance of quality standards for the manufacturing process. This role focuses on monitoring production quality, improving yield, reducing scrap, and ensuring that manufacturing processes operate within defined control limits. The QE analyzes production and quality data, supports Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for process deviations, and participates in Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) activities. This position works closely with Production, Engineering, and Quality teams to improve product quality and process reliability. Duties / Responsibilities * **Process Control \& SPC:** Support and maintain Statistical Process Control (SPC) programs. Analyze trends such as Cp/Cpk and assist in identifying process shifts and potential quality issues. * **Risk Management:** Participate in Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) activities and support implementation of risk mitigation actions. * **Quality Documentation:** Create and update Quality Control Plans, Inspection Standards, and Work Instructions (WIs). * **Root Cause Analysis \& CAPA:** Participate in problem\-solving activities using tools such as 8D, 5\-Why, and Fishbone Analysis for internal non\-conformances and customer\-related quality issues. Support CAPA activities and follow\-up actions. * **Yield Improvement:** Monitor and report daily/weekly production yield, identify major loss contributors, and work with cross\-functional teams on defect reduction and process improvement activities. * **NPI Support:** Support New Product Introduction (NPI), including quality validation of new equipment, materials, and manufacturing processes. * **Audit Support:** Support internal process audits and participate in external/customer audits, including ISO 9001, UL, IEC, CSA, and TUV. * **Change Management:** Review Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) with the Quality and Engineering teams to understand potential impacts on product quality and process stability. * Perform other quality\-related duties as assigned by the manager. Required Skills / Abilities * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel; exposure to statistical software such as Minitab or JMP is a plus. * Basic understanding of statistical analysis, quality tools, and manufacturing processes. * Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, SPC, or other continuous improvement methodologies is preferred. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills. * Ability to prioritize tasks and communicate quality concerns appropriately. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability and willingness to learn solar module manufacturing processes and quality standards. Education and Experience * **Required:** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Materials Science, or a related engineering discipline). * Bingual in Mandarin would be strongly preferred for team colleboration * **Experience:** Entry\-level candidates and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Previous full\-time work experience is not required. * Internship, co\-op, academic project, or other exposure to manufacturing, quality, or engineering environments is preferred. * Familiarity with ISO 9001, Six Sigma, SPC, or quality engineering tools is a plus. * Previous exposure to Solar/PV manufacturing is a plus but not required. Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $63,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Can you speak Mandarin? Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Generative AI/ML** **About the Role:** We are seeking a **Generative AI/ML** with an innovative and forward\-thinking mindset to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be passionate about artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and large language models (LLMs), with the ability to design, develop, and deploy GenAI\-driven solutions that transform business processes and enhance productivity. platforms. **Experience Required:** 4\+ years **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and develop applications and workflows using **Generative AI** and **Large Language Models (LLMs)**. * Fine\-tune pre\-trained models to meet specific business needs and improve performance. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities for AI\-driven innovation. * Build prompt engineering strategies to optimize model outputs. * Research and prototype new approaches in text, image, and multimodal generation. * Implement scalable GenAI solutions using APIs and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). * Evaluate and monitor AI model accuracy, bias, and performance metrics. * Stay up to date with the latest trends in GenAI, NLP, and machine learning technologies. **Required **Generative AI** and **NLP**. * Strong understanding of transformer\-based architectures (e.g., GPT, LLaMA, Claude, Gemini). * Hands\-on experience with **Python**, **LangChain**, **Hugging Face**, problem\-solving and creative thinking skills. **Preferred Skills:** * Experience with multimodal AI (text, image, or audio generation). * Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma). Work with cutting\-edge AI tools and technologies. * Collaborative and innovative environment that values experimentation. * Opportunities to shape the future of AI\-driven business transformation.

jobs.title: IOS Developer - USC and GC Full Time Role
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a passionate and motivated iOS Developer with 6 months to 4 years of experience in developing mobile applications for Apple devices. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of iOS development, be willing to work in an onsite or hybrid environment, and be open to relocating anywhere within the United States. **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Work Authorization:** US Citizens and Green Card holders only **Experience Required:** 4\+ Years **Work Mode:** Onsite / Hybrid **Relocation:** Must be open to relocate anywhere in the United States **Key Responsibilities** * Design and develop high\-quality iOS applications using Swift and/or Objective\-C * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including UI/UX designers, product managers, and backend developers * Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices * Integrate RESTful APIs and third\-party libraries * Perform unit testing and debugging to ensure application stability * Participate in code reviews and Agile/Scrum ceremonies * Maintain and enhance existing iOS applications **Required Skills** * Strong knowledge of **Swift** (Objective\-C is a plus) * Experience with **Xcode**, iOS SDK, and Interface Builder * Understanding of **UIKit**, Auto Layout, and Apple Human Interface Guidelines * Experience integrating **REST APIs** and handling JSON data * Knowledge of **Git** or other version control systems * Familiarity with **MVVM/MVC architecture patterns** * Basic understanding of App Store deployment process **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Core Data, Realm, or other local storage solutions * Exposure to CI/CD pipelines * Knowledge of unit testing frameworks (XCTest) * Understanding of mobile app performance optimization

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Engineering Manager** **POSITION SUMMARY** The Engineering Manager is responsible for driving engineering excellence across the organization. Through a team of manufacturing \& controls engineers, this role establishes engineering standards, oversees capital project execution, improves manufacturing processes, and builds the engineering capabilities needed to support future growth. The Engineering Manager serves as the technical leader for manufacturing engineering and automation, partnering closely with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing systems. **WORK SCHEDULE \& AVAILABILITY** This is a full\-time, on\-site role. The Engineering Manager is expected to maintain regular and predictable attendance. This role may require schedule flexibility to support manufacturing operations, capital projects, equipment installations, startups, shutdowns, and urgent operational needs. Occasional travel to suppliers, contract manufacturing locations, and company facilities may be required. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** **Leadership and Team Development** * Provide leadership, coaching, and technical direction to the engineering team while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. * Establish engineering priorities that align with company objectives and operational needs. * Develop the technical capabilities of the engineering team through mentoring, training, and performance development. * Promote collaboration between Sales, Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain. **Engineering Standards and Documentation** * Develop, implement, and maintain engineering standards for mechanical design, electrical systems, controls architecture, automation, documentation, and project execution. * Standardize equipment specifications, preferred vendors, control philosophies, and engineering documentation across manufacturing operations. * Ensure engineering drawings, equipment documentation, controls backups, and technical records are accurate and maintained. * Drive consistency in engineering practices to improve equipment reliability, maintainability, and long\-term asset performance. **Project and Capital Execution** * Manage contractors, engineering consultants, equipment suppliers, and installation teams. * Ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and achieve expected operational results. * Provide regular communication on project status, risks, and financial performance to leadership. **Process Improvement and Automation** * Lead equipment and process improvement projects focused on reducing downtime, improving throughput, and minimizing waste. * Apply Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles to eliminate process variation and improve operational performance. * Provide technical oversight for plant automation systems including PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, drives, and process control systems. * Identify automation opportunities that improve productivity, operator effectiveness, safety, and product quality. * Ensure manufacturing control systems remain reliable, scalable, and aligned with future business needs. **Operational Support and Strategic Planning** * Partner with Operations and Maintenance to improve equipment reliability and maximize production uptime. * Provide engineering support during equipment failures, major repairs, and production challenges. * Support new product introductions by evaluating manufacturing capabilities and identifying equipment or process modifications. * Participate in strategic capacity planning and facility expansion initiatives. * Ensure engineering activities comply with food safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory requirements. * Develop and manage engineering and capital budgets. * Support long\-range manufacturing strategies by developing engineering roadmaps aligned with business growth. **DISCLAIMER** The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this role. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required. Team members may be required to perform duties outside of their usual responsibilities as needed, and management reserves the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related engineering discipline required. * Professional Engineer (PE), Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, or similar professional certification preferred. * Minimum of 7 years of progressive engineering experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably within food, dairy, beverage, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or other high\-speed manufacturing industries. * Minimum of 3 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams, technical professionals, or major capital projects. * Demonstrated experience leading capital projects from concept through startup and commissioning. * Experience supporting manufacturing operations through equipment design, process improvement, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Experience in food manufacturing or other FDA/USDA regulated industries. * Experience implementing engineering standards and leading manufacturing standardization initiatives. * Experience with ERP, CMMS, or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). **Skills and Competencies:** * Familiarity with engineering drawings, P\&IDs, electrical schematics, and technical documentation. * Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management software; experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar engineering software preferred. * Knowledge of food safety principles, GMPs, and sanitary equipment design. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * **Mobility:** Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods throughout office and manufacturing environments, including walking through production areas, maintenance shops, utility areas, and project installation sites. * **Access and Movement:** Ability to occasionally bend, stoop, reach, climb stairs, and navigate around equipment, piping, platforms, and active work areas as needed. * **Manual Dexterity:** Ability to use hands and fingers to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, phone, tools, controls, and other office or technical equipment. * **Physical Strength:** Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull up to 25 pounds, including laptops, files, tools, parts, equipment components, or project materials. * **Vision:** Visual acuity required for reading technical documents, engineering drawings, screens, labels, equipment indicators, and observing work performed in production or project areas. This includes close, distance, color, peripheral, and depth vision, with or without correction. * **Communication:** Ability to speak clearly and hear within the normal audio range, with or without correction, to communicate effectively in office settings and manufacturing environments where elevated noise levels may be present. * **Safety Requirements:** Ability to wear required personal protective equipment, follow site safety requirements, and work safely around active manufacturing equipment and construction or installation activities. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** This role operates in both a professional office setting and active manufacturing environments. The Engineering Manager regularly works in or around production areas, maintenance shops, utilities, and project installation areas where active industrial equipment, varying temperatures, wet conditions, elevated noise levels, flashing or strobe lights, and strong magnetic fields may be present. The role requires adherence to all safety, food safety, GMP, PPE, and site access requirements. **BENEFITS** * 401K with a generous match * Vacation * Insurance (Health, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life) * Bonus Plan * Unique Wellness Incentives **WHY HUDSONVILLE ICE CREAM** At Hudsonville Ice Cream, we offer a first\-class work environment with a real family feel. We appreciate and recognize the hard work and dedication of our team members. We firmly believe that our team members’ fiscal, physical, and mental health are essential elements to our organization’s overall success. It is with this philosophy in mind that we offer a competitive wage and benefits package that starts day one. Moreover, Hudsonville Ice Cream is committed to its team members' continual growth and development.

jobs.title: Salesforce Sr Developer
jobs.description: **Description** =============== The Huntington Salesforce Center of Excellence (COE) team is seeking Sr\-level Salesforce Developer to participate in development activities spanning multiple Salesforce platforms. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer- Aerospace and Defense
jobs.description: **Company Description** ----------------------- IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 6000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge. At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but also on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust. We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world. We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **\#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference. If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS. **Job Description** ------------------- **About our Aerospace \& Defense business** Our Aerospace \& Defense business helps the world's leading airlines, MROs, OEMs and defense operators keep complex fleets and platforms mission\-ready — managing the full maintenance, asset and service lifecycle at scale. We are changing how that software gets built: closer to the operations it serves, in shorter cycles, and increasingly with AI. That means investing in engineers who work at the point of contact between our products and our customers. **Qualifications** ------------------ As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer in our Aerospace \& Defense business, you build aviation products directly with our customers. You embed with the airlines, MROs, OEMs and defense operators who keep complex fleets flying, work alongside their people in their own environments, and turn what you see there into working software — shipped quickly, hardened in real operations, and fed back into the product so every customer benefits. This is engineering at the point of contact: the shortest path between a customer's problem and a product that solves it. The role is deliberately broad. You build across the stack — backend services and APIs, data models and integrations, web interfaces — and you own what you ship end to end, from design and testing through deployment and operational reliability in customer environments. You connect IFS to the systems that run our customers' operations, and you do it under real constraints: live fleets, regulated processes, restricted networks and firm deadlines. AI is becoming both part of how we build and part of what we ship, so experience building AI\-powered solutions is a strong advantage. **What you'll do** * **Build with the customer.** Embed with Aerospace \& Defense customers — on their sites and inside their systems — to learn how their operation actually works, then design and ship software with them rather than for them. You shorten the loop between a real problem and a working answer. * **Ship across the stack.** Design, build and test full\-stack features in modern general\-purpose languages — services and APIs, data and persistence, integrations and web interfaces. Breadth matters more than depth in any one framework here. * **Integrate into real operations.** Connect IFS to the systems that run our customers' businesses — ERP, CRM, IoT and telemetry, and long\-lived legacy and mission systems — and own the solution architecture in real customer context. * **Own delivery end to end.** You build it, you run it: automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, observability and operational reliability across cloud and customer environments. When it breaks in production, you are the one who makes it right. * **Bring AI into the work.** Use AI\-assisted and agentic development tooling as a normal part of how you build, and help take AI\-powered product capabilities into customer environments where they have to hold up under real conditions. * **Turn field work into product.** Feed what you learn on site back into the core product and the roadmap, so a fix for one customer becomes a capability for all of them. You work closely with product management and the wider engineering teams to make that happen. * **Represent IFS credibly.** Be the technical voice customers trust — able to work through a design with their engineers, explain a trade\-off to an operations leader, and hold your own in front of partners. **What you'll bring** Essential * **Full\-stack breadth:** hands\-on experience designing, building and shipping production software across the stack — backend services and APIs, data and integrations, and web front ends — with proficiency in modern general\-purpose programming languages rather than a single domain framework. * **Customer\-facing delivery:** substantial experience working directly with customers, on site or embedded in their teams, to deploy, integrate, harden and support enterprise software in their own environment — including integration with systems such as ERP, CRM, IoT and legacy platforms. * **End\-to\-end ownership:** a you\-build\-it, you\-run\-it mindset with real accountability for what you ship — quality and automated testing, CI/CD, cloud and DevOps, and security. * **Senior\-level autonomy:** a track record of owning significant pieces of delivery with little supervision, making sound architecture and shipping\-quality calls under time pressure, and raising the standard of the engineers around you. * **Communication and judgement:** excellent communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and the instinct to ground technical decisions in direct customer evidence and business value. * **Willingness to travel** to customer sites as the work requires. jobs.title: Supplier Quality & Compliance Engineer
jobs.description: Founded in 1961, we are a growing manufacturing company. IMMI® is the trusted, global leader of safety solutions, helping to protect millions of lives every day. For over sixty\-five years, IMMI has led the way in developing, designing, testing, and manufacturing innovative safety restraints and systems. IMMI’s safety products are found worldwide on car seats, heavy trucks, school buses, recreational/off road, military, fire/EMS, motor coach, and construction vehicles. IMMI recently became an ESOP giving team members the opportunity to become owners and share in the company’s future success. IMMI is a dynamic organization serving more than eleven markets and hundreds of customers across multiple countries. IMMI is also home to IMMI VIP steering wheels and CAPE®, the world’s leading state\-of\-the\-art testing facility. IMMI is seeking a qualified and highly motivated individual to fill the role of **Supplier Quality and Compliance Engineer** who is responsible for leading IMMI's chemical compliance, product stewardship, and programs while ensuring alignment with the organization's Quality Management System. This role provides leadership for compliance related to chemicals, hazardous substances, environmental regulations, customer material disclosure requirements, and supplier compliance activities. **Supplier Quality and Compliance Engineer** work cross\-functionally with Engineering, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, EHS, Manufacturing, and external suppliers to ensure products and manufacturing processes meet applicable customer, legal and quality requirements. This individual serves as the subject matter expert for global chemical regulations while driving continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, process performance, and compliance.**Primary Duties and Responsibilities****Compliance \& Product Stewardship*** Monitor, interpret, and communicate emerging global regulations that impact IMMI products, materials, and manufacturing operations. * Lead compliance activities related to: + REACH + RoHS + TSCA + Proposition 65 + PFAS regulations + GADSL + ELV Directive + Conflict Minerals + Customer\-specific material disclosure requirements * Develop and maintain compliance policies, procedures, and work instructions. * Conduct impact assessments and risk evaluations for new and existing products. * Manage customer requests involving material declarations, substance restrictions, and compliance certifications. * Serve as the primary point of contact regarding chemical compliance and product stewardship matters. **Quality Systems Integration*** Support implementation and continuous improvement of IMMI's Quality Management System. * Ensure chemical compliance processes align with customer, industry, and internal quality standards. * Develop standards and methods for inspection, testing, evaluation, and monitoring of materials affecting compliance. * Utilize Total Quality Management principles and problem\-solving methodologies to improve product compliance processes. * Participate in internal audits, customer audits, supplier audits, and compliance assessments. * Monitor compliance metrics and drive corrective actions to address identified gaps. **Supplier Compliance \& Supplier Quality*** Develop and maintain supplier compliance programs for chemical and material reporting. * Evaluate supplier systems and processes to ensure adherence to IMMI's quality and expectations. * Review supplier material disclosures, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), technical data sheets, and compliance certifications. * Manage supplier corrective actions related to non\-compliance issues. * Support supplier qualification, PPAP activities, audits, and ongoing supplier performance management. * Partners with Purchasing Engineering and Supply Chain teams ensure requirements are incorporated into supplier agreements and qualification activities. **Product Quality \& Risk Management*** Develop a thorough understanding of IMMI products, materials, manufacturing processes, and customer requirements. * Evaluate chemical and material risks that may impact product quality, safety, reliability, or compliance. * Support APQP activities, FMEA development, Control Plans, and validation processes. * Participate in root cause investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Utilize data\-driven decision\-making methodologies including: + SPC + DOE + FMEA + CAPA + Risk Assessment Tools * Support containment, investigation, and disposition activities involving non\-conforming materials. **Data Analysis, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement*** Analyze compliance and quality performance data to identify trends and improvement opportunities. * Develop reporting tools and dashboards that monitor compliance performance. * Track and report key regulatory, supplier, and quality metrics. * Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing compliance risk and improving operational effectiveness. * Provide regular status updates to leadership regarding regulatory developments and business impacts. **Training \& Organizational Support*** Develop and deliver training programs related to: + Chemical regulations + Product stewardship + Hazard communication + Supplier compliance + Quality tools and methodologies * Mentor team members and support organizational awareness of compliance responsibilities. * Maintain current knowledge of industry standards, regulations, and compliance best practices. **Required Qualifications****Experience*** 7\+ years of experience in: + Quality Engineering + Manufacturing Quality + Environmental Compliance * Experience in automotive, transportation, industrial manufacturing, or a similarly regulated environment. **Technical Knowledge** Comprehensive knowledge of:* REACH * RoHS * TSCA * PFAS regulations * Proposition 65 * GADSL * IMDS * SCIP * Conflict Minerals * SDS Management * APQP * PPAP * FMEA * Control Plans * SPC * DOE * Corrective Action Systems * Root Cause Analysis * IATF 16949 * ISO 9001 * ISO 14001 **Skills*** Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into business processes. * Excellent communication and presentation skills. * Strong project management and organizational skills. * Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority. * Ability to manage multiple priorities within a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and compliance reporting systems. **Preferred Qualifications****Education*** Bachelor's Degree Preferred/or equivalent experience in: + Chemistry + Materials Science + Environmental Science + Engineering * Related technical discipline * Experience with Assent, BOMcheck, IMDS, CDX, or similar compliance management platforms. * Experience supporting OEM automotive customers. * Working knowledge of welding, fabrication, cutting and sewing, molding, or assembly manufacturing processes. * Spanish language proficiency. **Key Success Measures*** Supplier compliance completion rate. * Customer compliance response performance. * Audit findings and closure effectiveness. * Reduction of compliance\-related business risk. * Supplier corrective action effectiveness. * Product compliance certification accuracy. * Quality system audit performance. * Continuous improvement project results. **Location:** Westfield, Indiana **Benefits:*** Team Member Ownership/ESOP * Healthcare, vision, dental options * Company Paid Long and Short\-Term Disability Insurance * Ten (10\) paid holidays * Four (4\) IMMI Serves volunteer days per year * Onsite Health and Wellness Clinic * Generous Paid Time Off * Bonus Opportunities * 401k * Tuition Assistance

The role participates in key phases of the trim development process, including concept development, pattern creation, material evaluation, design validation, documentation, supplies interaction and launch support. product and process improvements throughout the development lifecycle. **Primary Duties and Responsibilities:** **Design \& Production** * Support design and production implementation of soft trim components, ensuring compliance with engineering specs, customer requirements, and regulatory standards. * Develop and release trim cover drawings and patterns using cut\-and\-sew construction techniques. * Follow and maintain sewing specifications and appearance standards for all trim parts and assemblies. * Develop and manage bills of materials (eBOM) for prototypes and production, identifying tooling and compliance requirements. **Project Management** * Prepare and manage comprehensive project plans outlining key deliverables, including: + Trim development timelines + eBOMs with preliminary usage and utilization rates + Trim patterns, drawings, and master appearance samples + Trim specifications and retainer/attachment concepts + CASO process initiation and documentation * Provide initial cost analysis and quoting support for soft trim components and sub\-assemblies. **Collaboration \& Communication** * Collaborate with manufacturing engineers to train/optimize sewing processes, layouts, and support troubleshooting. * Coordinate with suppliers to evaluate materials, tooling readiness, and construction methods. * Maintain effective communication with internal teams and external partners to ensure timely and accurate deliverables. **Quality \& Compliance** * Create and maintain essential documentation including DFMEA, DVP\&R, APQP, and PPAP records. * Support IMMI’s Quality Management System and ensure adherence to ISO/TS 16949 and ISO 14000 standards. * Conduct post\-launch quality audits and participate in root cause analysis and corrective actions. * Review design information to confirm quality, completeness, and compliance with IMMI requirements. * Uphold health, safety, and environmental standards, participating in investigations and reporting as needed. **Operational Support and Continuous Improvement** * Manage inventory and ordering of soft trim development materials across programs. * Identify opportunities for process improvements and lead implementation efforts. **Competencies:** * Associates degree in Textile Engineering, Industrial Design, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field; *Equivalent experience (3\-5\+ years in trim development may be considered in lieu of a degree)* * Minimum of 3\-5 years of experience in soft trim and foam development, including cut\-and\-sew component design and foam skiving, with expertise in A\-surface management * Proven record of full project lifecycle ownership, from Phase 0 to production launch, and Trim cover development. * Experience working with automotive and commercial seating systems, including material specifications and manufacturing integration. * Proficient in pattern development (both paper and digital), cut\-and\-sew construction, and trim material selection (e.g., vinyl, leather, foam, fabric). * Knowledgeable in foam sculpting, surface aesthetics, and trim attachment techniques * Familiarity with DVP\&R, DFMEA, DFM/A, APQP, PPAP, and control plan documentation * Skilled in interpreting engineering drawings, applying GD\&T, and developing appearance standards * Strong understanding of ISO/TS16949, ISO 14000, and automotive compliance requirements (e.g., FMVSS, ECE) * Excellent verbal and written communication skills; confident in technical presentations and cross\-functional meetings * High level of organizational skill, time management, and ability to manage multiple projects in parallel * Demonstrated success in mentoring co\-workers, driving quality outcomes, and executing continuous improvement * Willingness and ability to travel domestically or internationally as needed to support suppliers, customers, or production sites * Advanced English (essential). **Required Tools:** * CAD Software: SolidWorks and CATIA, – for 3D modeling * Pattern Design: Optitex PDS, AccuMark and Lectra, – for 2D/3D trim patterns and digital sewing layouts * PLM Systems: Oracle Fusion, Teamcenter, Trim PDM – for BOMs, design revisions, and document control * DFMEA / PFMEA – for design and process risk assessments * DVP\&R – for design verification and validation planning * APQP / PPAP Templates – for product and process approvals * Material Test Equipment – for seam strength, abrasion, and flammability (FMVSS 302\) * Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) – for reporting and documentation * Sewing Equipment Interfaces – for programming and monitoring stitching accuracy * Manual Trim Tools – foam skiving, hand trimming, and pattern grading **Physical Requirements:** * Prolonged periods sitting/standing at a desk and working on a computer. * Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally. * Ability to visually inspect and interpret designs on screen and in print. * Use of functional Core Tools. **Health and Safety Responsibilities:** * Use and take care of the personal protective equipment provided by the company, for the different activities carried out. * Attend and actively participate in health and safety training. * Comply with the different processes, procedures and regulations of Occupational Health and Safety established. * Report any unsafe acts or conditions. * Report any security incidents. * Actively participate in incident investigations when required. **Location:** Westfield, Indiana **Reports To:** Trim Engineering Supervisor **Benefits:** * Team Member Ownership/ESOP * Healthcare, vision, dental options * Company Paid Long and Short\-Term Disability Insurance * Ten (10\) paid holidays * Four (4\) IMMI Serves volunteer days per year * Onsite Health and Wellness Clinic * Generous Paid Time Off * Bonus Opportunities * 401k * Tuition Assistance

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Labrynth
jobs.description: **About Labrynth** ------------------ Labrynth accelerates progress by streamlining regulatory complexity. We build AI\-powered platforms that navigate complex regulations, generate audit\-level documentation, and provide certainty, not shortcuts. Our technology serves clients across heavily regulated industries including energy, compliance, and government regulations. We operate as a forward\-deployed engineering organization: small, high\-velocity teams embedded directly with clients to rapidly discover needs and ship production\-quality solutions. **About the Role** ------------------ We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers on regulated, operational workflows and turn that field work into a production product. FDEs sit close to the customer and close to the code. You will map real workflows, identify the first useful product slice, implement it, verify it, demo it truthfully, and help decide what should become a reusable platform. The work spans three modes: * **Field:** shadow operators, model decisions, find evidence sources, and understand where the workflow is slow, risky, or brittle. * **Build:** ship production slices across UI, API, data, permissions, tests, and deployment paths. * **Productize:** turn customer\-specific learning into primitives, configuration, evals, playbooks, or roadmap changes. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Run customer discovery, workflow shadowing, and field notes with operators and decision owners, until you can name the users, states, evidence sources, exceptions, and the real operating constraint * Implement thin product slices in a live codebase across frontend, backend, data, and integrations, where the happy path works, unsafe paths fail, and the behavior survives realistic data * Write tests, run realistic paths, inspect logs, and document what is proven, missing, or uncertain, so every customer demo is backed by evidence, not optimism * Explain tradeoffs, risks, and next steps to non\-technical customers without overclaiming * Identify reusable patterns from field work and feed them into product and engineering, so the next customer gets faster onboarding, safer workflows, or more reusable product * Carry ambiguous work end to end: discovery, build, demo, rollout, and follow\-up **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We don't need you to have used every tool in our stack. We need someone who can move safely across this kind of system and learn the missing pieces quickly. * You have personally shipped production software and can explain what you touched, how you verified it, and what changed for users * You are comfortable in messy customer settings where the first request is rarely the real problem * You can talk to operators in plain language, then go back to the codebase and build the thing * **Product UI:** TypeScript, React, Next.js, shadcn/Tailwind; you can trace a user flow, change a screen, and respect server/client boundaries * **Backend:** Python (uv), Pydantic, Django/Django Ninja or FastAPI, background workers, and typed APIs * **Data and auth:** Postgres, migrations, service roles, tenant scoping, and auditability * **AI systems:** pydantic\-ai agents, typed outputs, evals, and provider choice across Gemini, OpenAI, and Bedrock; you use AI tools for leverage but never treat generated output or a clean demo as proof * **Cloud:** Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS, GCP; you can debug across deployment, env config, logs, and customer\-facing behavior * **Evidence discipline:** you naturally separate fact, inference, assumption, and risk * **Product judgment:** you resist one\-off customization unless the lesson clearly belongs outside core product * **Strong communication skills**: you can explain what is safe, what is uncertain, and what happens next **Nice to Have** ---------------- * AWS experience (IAM, GitHub OIDC, Lambda, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, least privilege); * Infrastructure as code experience * Experience in regulated industries (energy, compliance, government permitting, healthcare, finance) * Prior forward deployed, solutions, or founding engineer experience **What We Offer** ----------------- * High\-impact work at the intersection of AI and critical infrastructure regulation * Direct customer exposure and a seat at the table when we decide what to build * Small team with outsized influence; your field learning shapes the product roadmap * Modern AI\-native development environment (Claude Code, Cursor, multi\-model orchestration) * Remote\-first * Competitive compensation **Values We Hire For** ---------------------- * **Character:** integrity and trustworthiness above all * **Competency:** evoking trust and reliably delivering * **Togetherness:** family\-level support and alignment * **Impact:** meaningful outcomes over activity * **Commitment:** ownership and follow\-through **What’s In It For You** Labrynth is committed to fair and competitive pay, ensuring that compensation reflects both market conditions and the value each team member brings. For this position, the annual salary ranges by location are: **Salary Range** $140,000 \- $180,000 USD * Offers also include bonus \+ equity Compensation is based on location, experience, skills, internal equity, and market conditions. For candidates outside the U.S., pay is aligned with local market conditions and cost of living. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm the applicable compensation range and benefits during the interview process. *Equal Opportunity Statement:* *We’re an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.*

Ivanti helps organisations work smarter through Autonomous Endpoint Management powered by our AI‑driven Ivanti Neurons platform—delivering better outcomes for our customers by reducing complexity and enabling proactive IT and security operations. **About the Role** We're looking for a rare, full\-stack data and AI practitioner who can operate fluidly from raw data all the way to production AI systems and the enterprise architecture that supports them. You will ingest and reason over everything from highly structured warehouse data in Snowflake to messy unstructured sources, turn it into defensible analytics, and ship agentic AI solutions that are both intelligent and ruthlessly cost\-efficient. This is a builder\-first role with real architectural ownership. You'll write the models and the agents yourself, *and* you'll define the reference architectures, patterns, and standards that let the rest of the organization build on top of your work. If you're equally comfortable defending a confidence interval and a system\-design decision, this role is for you. **What You'll Do** * **Unify structured and unstructured data.** Build pipelines that pull structured data from Snowflake (and adjacent warehouses/lakes) alongside unstructured sources — text, documents, logs, transcripts — into clean, modeling\-ready datasets. * **Deliver decision\-grade analytics.** Produce customer churn analytics with properly quantified uncertainty (confidence/credible intervals), not just point estimates, and communicate what the numbers can and can't support. * **Build predictive and prescriptive models.** Move beyond "what will happen" to "what should we do about it" — forecasting, propensity, and optimization/recommendation systems that drive concrete business actions. * **Engineer agentic AI systems.** Design and ship LLM\-powered agents and workflows that are token\-efficient by design — tight context management, retrieval and caching strategies, model routing, and evaluation harnesses that keep cost and latency low without sacrificing quality. * **Architect for the enterprise.** Define reference architectures, integration patterns, and governance standards spanning data ingestion, model development, MLOps/LLMOps, security, and observability — and bring stakeholders along with clear diagrams and documentation. * **Own quality and reliability.** Establish evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails for drift, accuracy, bias, safety, and cost across both classical ML and GenAI systems. * **Partner across the business.** Translate ambiguous business problems into technical solutions and explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders. **What You Bring (Required)** * Strong hands\-on data engineering with **Snowflake** (modeling, performance, cost management) and SQL, plus experience wrangling unstructured data. * Solid applied statistics: you can build churn/retention models and correctly express **uncertainty with confidence or credible intervals**, and you understand the assumptions behind them. * Demonstrated experience building **predictive and prescriptive analytics** that shipped and influenced decisions. * Production experience with **LLM/agentic systems** — frameworks such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK, CrewAI, or custom orchestrators — with a real track record of **optimizing for token efficiency, cost, and latency**. * Production **RAG** experience (chunking, hybrid search, reranking, retrieval evals) is strongly expected at the senior\+ level. * **Architecture chops:** you can design and document end\-to\-end systems and patterns others build on, and defend those decisions with evidence. * Strong Python and a software\-engineering mindset (testing, version control, CI/CD). * Excellent written and verbal communication; comfort working asynchronously in a distributed team. **Nice to Have (Preferred)** * Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer, Azure AI Engineer) and/or **TOGAF** for enterprise architecture. * Experience with inference optimization (quantization, model routing, caching, vLLM/TensorRT\-style serving). * MLOps/LLMOps tooling and platform\-building experience. * Domain experience in \[your industry], and prior work owning AI strategy or build\-vs\-buy decisions. **What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)** * A unified data foundation that combines Snowflake and unstructured sources for downstream modeling. * A churn analytics product trusted by the business, with quantified uncertainty and clear recommended actions. * At least one production agentic solution that demonstrably reduces token spend/latency versus a naive baseline while meeting quality bars. * A documented reference architecture and set of standards adopted by other teams. **Why Ivanti?** * **Friendly flexible working model:** Empower excellence whether you're at home or in the office and support work\-life balance**.** * **Competitive compensation \& total rewards**: Including health, wellness, and financial plans tailored for you and your family. * **Global, diverse teams:**Collaborate with talented people from 23\+ countries. * **Learning \& development:**Grow your skills with access to best\-in\-class learning tools and programs. * **Equity \& belonging:**We value every voice. Your story helps inform our solutions for a changing world. **What drives us** Ivanti's mission is to elevate human potential within organizations by managing, protecting and automating technology for continuous innovation. It is through diverse and inclusive hiring, decision\-making, and commitment to our employees and partners that we will continue to build and deliver world\-class solutions for our customers. *To learn more about Ivanti's* *Mission and Core Values.* **Inclusion at Ivanti** Ivanti is proud to be an **Equal Opportunity Employer**. We're committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Palantir Foundry & Custom Development)
jobs.description: Location Dallas, Texas, United States Capabilities Digital and Data Office Setup Hybrid Job ID \#45696 Industry Advanced Manufacturing At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Your impact We're looking for a **Forward Deployed Engineer** (FDE I) to build alongside more experienced FDEs, Implementation Leads, and Architects, executing well\-defined requirements across Foundry and custom applications. You'll work across multiple active projects, learning to move between domains quickly — with guidance close at hand when requirements are unclear or you're in unfamiliar territory. This isn't a role where you get one project and go deep for a year; you'll be building real range early in your career, with support built into how the work is structured. This role doesn't carry people leadership responsibility. What it does require is a strong technical foundation, genuine curiosity across both **Foundry and custom development**, and the ability to stay productive and ask good questions in a fast\-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment. **Compensation**: This role is open to Entry level, Intermediate and Associate levels so final pay will be based on experience level **What You'll Do** * **Build, Forward Deployed** — Work embedded with client and project teams to build and configure Foundry\-based and custom software features in response to defined requirements. * **Execute Well\-Defined Work** — Take clear direction from the Senior AI Solutions Architect or a Mid–Senior FDE and turn it into working code, Ontology objects, pipelines, or integrations — asking good questions when something's unclear rather than guessing. * **Support Multiple Projects** — Carry a workload across more than one project, learning to prioritize and context\-switch between codebases and problem domains without dropping quality. * **Ask for Direction** — Recognize when you're facing ambiguity or unfamiliar territory and proactively seek guidance rather than stalling or guessing. * **Follow Portfolio Standards** — Build to the patterns and standards set by more senior FDEs and the architect, so your work fits cleanly into the broader DPS portfolio. * **Debug \& Support** — Troubleshoot issues in features you've built, respond to feedback, and support existing applications alongside new work. * **Build Range** — Grow your skills across both Palantir Foundry and custom development, with support from senior team members as you branch into less familiar areas. * **Collaborate Cross\-Functionally** — Work alongside project managers, other developers, and subject matter experts as an active contributor, present in client sessions and supporting the technical conversation. Here's what you'll need **Must\-haves:** * 0–5 years of relevant experience — strong fundamentals and a genuine eagerness to build range across stacks. * Foundational experience with Palantir Foundry (Ontology, pipelines, applications) or demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly; AIP/OSDK exposure a plus. * Software development experience, including a modern JavaScript frontend framework (React preferred) and/or Python. * Comfort working across multiple projects — able to balance competing priorities with support from the team. * A fast\-paced, client\-facing mindset — comfortable with shifting requirements and being embedded with the people using what you build. **Strongly preferred:** * Exposure to REST APIs and relational or cloud\-native data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, MongoDB). * Interest in AI/LLM\-enabled features and using AI tools to accelerate your own development work. * Working knowledge of Agile delivery, Git, and CI/CD practices. * Prior internship, co\-op, or early\-career experience in a professional services, consulting, or client\-facing environment. * Education/Certifications — A relevant college degree and/or willingness to pursue certifications (e.g., Palantir Foundry certifications, cloud platform certifications) — equivalent hands\-on experience valued just as highly. **Location** * Hybrid in the United States, with occasional travel for project and client meetings, primarily in North America. * A list of offices can be found here: https://www.jacobs.com/locations/americas/united\-states Posted Salary Range: Minimum 80,000\.00 Posted Salary Range: Upper 110,000\.00 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well\-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full\-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock. The base salary range for this position is $80,000\.00 to $110,000\.00\. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on September 22, 2026\. This position will be open for at least 3 days. We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. jobs.title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer (Palantir Foundry & Custom Development)
jobs.description: Location Dallas, Texas, United States Capabilities Digital and Data Office Setup Hybrid Job ID \#45698 Industry Advanced Manufacturing At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Your impact We're looking for a **Mid\-Senior Forward Deployed Engineer** (FDE II) to own real ambiguity: taking a rough problem statement from the client, Implementation Lead, PM, or Architect, and driving it to a working solution with minimal hand\-holding, across Foundry and custom development alike. You'll work across multiple active projects at once, moving fluidly between domains, and you'll be looked to by junior FDEs for technical direction on the projects you're placed on. This isn't a role where you get one project and go deep for a year — you'll be the person other FDEs turn to when priorities shift or the path forward isn't obvious. This role doesn't carry formal people leadership responsibility, but it does carry real technical accountability: for the quality of a feature area, for the junior FDEs you're informally mentoring on a project. The digital solution you're building isn't the end goal — it's a value\-add meant to move the needle on the client's broader program: pulling in or protecting the schedule, lowering cost, or increasing certainty for the program as a whole, not just for the technical work itself. **Compensation**: This role is open to Mid and Senior levels, so final pay will be based on experience level **What You'll Do** * **Own Solutions End\-to\-End** — Take a rough problem statement and drive it to a working solution — including key design decisions — across Foundry\-based and custom software, with minimal direction. * **Lead Technically on Your Projects** — Serve as the go\-to technical resource for junior FDEs on your engagement — unblocking them, reviewing their work, and setting shift mid\-sprint — adapting without losing focus or output quality. * **Originate Portfolio Patterns** — Build with reuse in mind and create new patterns, frameworks, and standards — not just follow Here's what you'll need **Must\-haves:** * **6\+ years of relevant experience** — seasoned individual contributors who prefer building over managing but are ready to lead technically. * **Hands\-on experience with Palantir Foundry and AIP** — Ontology, pipelines, applications, OSDK, etc. * **Strong software development experience,** including a modern JavaScript frontend framework (React preferred) and Python, with genuine range across both Foundry and custom development. * **E****xperience incorporating AI/LLMs into production solutions** — not just using AI tools to write code faster but building AI/LLM\-enabled features into what you ship. * **Proven ability to operate with ambiguity** — comfortable taking a loosely defined problem and driving it to a solution with minimal direction. * **Comfort informally leading other engineers** — reviewing work, unblocking teammates, and setting technical direction without formal authority. **Strongly preferred:** * Strong experience with REST APIs and both relational and cloud\-native data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, MongoDB). * Solid working knowledge of Agile delivery, Git, and CI/CD practices. * Prior experience in a professional services, consulting, or client\-facing environment. * Education/Certifications — A relevant college degree and/or industry certifications (e.g., Palantir Foundry certifications, cloud platform certifications) are a plus; equivalent hands\-on experience is valued just as highly. **Location** * Hybrid in the United States, with occasional travel for project and client meetings, primarily in North America. * A list of offices can be found here: https://www.jacobs.com/locations/americas/united\-states Posted Salary Range: Minimum 120,000\.00 Posted Salary Range: Upper 160,000\.00 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. jobs.description: **Descripción de cargo** El técnico de operaciones en el área frontal de producción es responsable de asegurar la operación continua, eficiente y segura de la maquinaria asignada en la línea de manufactura. Efectuar el reemplazo de filtros, rodillos, bobinas (coils) y otros componentes críticos de los equipos. * Identificar y eliminar obstrucciones en las líneas de producción que puedan interrumpir el proceso. * Sustituir piezas mecánicas como bandas transportadoras, motores o sistemas de transmisión cuando sea necesario. * Ejecutar rutinas de mantenimiento preventivo de acuerdo con el calendario técnico definido por la empresa. * Operar maquinaria de producción conforme a los procedimientos operacionales estándar (SOPs). * Velar por el orden, la limpieza y el cumplimiento de normas de higiene en el área de trabajo. * Utilizar de forma adecuada los recursos, evitando desperdicio de materia prima o energía. * Adherirse estrictamente a las Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (BPM) y al Sistema de Inocuidad Alimentaria. * Participar activamente en cambios de línea, ajustes de formato o productos, colaborando para minimizar tiempos improductivos. * Identificar riesgos potenciales y comunicar condiciones inseguras para garantizar un entorno laboral seguro. **Requisitos del puesto** * Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en funciones técnicas relacionadas con maquinaria de manufactura. * jobs.title: Associate Director, Creative Technology - US GTM
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** **Your role** As a Creative Technologist, you will sit at the intersection of creativity, technology, and experience design, turning ideas into tangible digital experiences that help customers understand, adopt, and realize value from Kyndryl solutions. This role blends hands\-on prototyping with strategic collaboration, translating concepts into working demonstrations, interactive content, and scalable experience assets. You will balance experimentation with delivery, spending time both building and refining solutions and partnering with marketers, designers, and technologists to bring them to life. **What you will do** * Design and build interactive prototypes, demos, and experiential assets that clearly demonstrate technology value to customers * Translate creative concepts into functional technical solutions using web, immersive, or emerging technologies * Partner with brand, content, experience design, and technical teams to shape end\-to\-end digital experiences * Evaluate and apply new tools, platforms, and technologies to enhance storytelling and engagement * Develop proof\-of\-concepts that can be reused, scaled, or adapted across campaigns, events, and platforms * Document technical approaches and reusable components to support consistency and future adoption * Support customer\-facing moments such as events, briefings, and showcases with reliable, production\-ready experiences * Balance exploratory work with delivery, moving ideas from experimentation to execution Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID\-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. **Who You Are** **Required skills and experience** * Hands\-on experience building interactive digital experiences, prototypes, or demonstrations * Working knowledge of front\-end or experience\-focused technologies such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS, or comparable frameworks * Experience translating creative or design concepts into functional technical outputs * Ability to collaborate with designers, marketers, and engineers to deliver shared outcomes * Experience using prototyping or creative technology tools such as WebGL, AR/VR, game engines, or no\-code platforms * Ability to clearly explain technical concepts through demos, visuals, or working examples * Experience managing multiple initiatives while maintaining quality and reliability **Preferred skills and experience** * Experience supporting customer\-facing experiences such as events, showcases, or executive briefings * Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards, and inclusive experience practices * Experience working in enterprise or B2B technology environments * Exposure to data\-driven or AI\-enabled experiences * Background in creative agencies, innovation teams, or experience labs **Pay and Benefits** The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is \- $143,640 to $273,000 based on a full\-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job\-related skills and experience. For part\-time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area):$172,440 to $327,600 California (All Other): $158,040 to $300,360 Colorado: $143,640 to $273,000 Massachusetts/ Virginia: $143,640 to $300,360 New York City: $172,440 to $327,600 Washington: $158,040 to $300,360 Washington DC: $158,040 to $300,360 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. **Being You** Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** With state\-of\-the\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
