jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description: ### **Be the First. Build the Territory. Own the Greater Boston Market.** We're looking for a **driven, entrepreneurial Outside Sales Representative with experience in the climate control rental industry,** to become our **first dedicated salesperson in the Greater Boston region** and help build our climate control rental business from the ground up. This isn't a role for someone who wants to inherit a book of business and maintain existing accounts. We're looking for a **true hunter**\-someone who gets energized by breaking into a new market, opening doors, finding opportunities others haven't uncovered, and turning new relationships into long\-term customers. You'll take ownership of developing the Greater Boston territory, targeting customers across **construction, commercial, industrial, mechanical/HVAC, restoration, events, and other industries that rely on temporary heating, cooling, and climate control solutions.** You'll spend your time in the market\-prospecting, visiting jobsites, networking, identifying upcoming projects, building relationships with decision\-makers, and creating a pipeline where one doesn't exist today. As our **first salesperson in Boston**, you'll have the opportunity to put your fingerprints on the market. You'll help identify where the greatest opportunities are, determine which customers and industries to pursue, build our local presence, and establish relationships that can fuel our growth for years to come. We're looking for someone who: * **Creates opportunities instead of waiting for leads.** * Is comfortable walking onto a jobsite, making a cold call, or introducing themselves to a new customer. * Knows how to build a territory and consistently develop new business. * Is competitive, persistent, resourceful, and comfortable hearing "no." * Builds genuine relationships and earns customer trust. * Understands their market and keeps their eyes open for the next project or opportunity. * Thrives with autonomy and doesn't need someone telling them what to do next. * Wants to be measured by the business they build and the customers they win. You'll have the freedom to **run the Greater Boston territory like it's your own business**, backed by the equipment, resources, expertise, and support of a growing organization. If you're the kind of salesperson who looks at an undeveloped territory and sees **opportunity rather than uncertainty**, we want to talk to you. **Come be the person who builds Boston.** **About Us** **At REIC Rentals, we don't just offer solutions \- we engineer excellence.** As a leader in delivering top\-tier rental solutions across Construction, oil \& Gas, Industrial, and Event sectors. **REIC Rentals** is a trusted full\-service equipment partner supporting major projects across North America. With more than 55 locations, we serve customers in the Oil \& Gas, Construction, Industrial, and Event industries. Our commitment to high\-performance equipment, expert technical support, and innovative solutions helps our customers operate safely, efficiently, and successfully. **What you will do:*** **Identify \& Engage:** Scout and pursue new project opportunities through research, outreach, conferences, and digital platforms. * **Build Partnerships:** Forge lasting relationships with potential and existing clients to unlock long\-term value. * **Drive Strategy:** Design and execute business development initiatives aligned with our growth goals. * **Lead Negotiations:** Craft compelling pricing proposals and contracts, and support executive teams during deal negotiations. * **Analyze \& Optimize:** Collaborate with finance and operations teams to monitor project performance and continuously improve outcomes. * **Support Marketing:** Coordinate promotional efforts to amplify product visibility and customer engagement. * **Represent REIC:** Attend trade shows and industry events to keep a pulse on market trends and build brand presence. * **Enable Sales:** Partner with internal teams to deliver product demos, customer training, and smooth onboarding experiences. **What You Bring*** 5\-10 yrs \+ Proven success in sales or business development roles, with a focus on **strategic growth** and **customer engagement in the equipment rental or related industries (construction, oil \& gas, industrial or ag equipment manufacturing, etc.)**. * Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. * Strong analytical abilities with experience in forecasting, pricing, and financial modeling. * Proficiency with CRM systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and project management tools. * Willingness to travel for client meetings, trade shows, and industry events. **Why Join REIC Rentals?*** Competitive base pay \+ UNCAPPED commission * Company vehicle, mobile phone and laptop * Competitive Health, Vision, and Dental Benefits available for full\-time employees \& family members, 401K with match, paid life insurance and generous paid time off and company paid holidays. * **Growth\-Focused Culture:** We empower employees to take initiative and shape the future. * other to do their best work. * **Career Development:** We invest in your success through ongoing training, mentorship, and advancement opportunities. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer I
jobs.description: * **Standort(e):** * Chicago, IL, US, 60654 * Austin, TX, US, 78701 **RWE Americas, LLC** **To start as soon as possible, full time, permanent** **Functional area:** IT / Digital **Remuneration:** Exempt The **Senior AI Engineer I** is a hands\-on engineer accountable for end\-to\-end AI capabilities within a product or across multiple products, from design and build through operation in production. Scope includes retrieval and context assembly, model and agentic logic, integration with source systems and consuming applications, monitoring and evaluation, and operational runbook maintenance. Depth is expected in two or three of these capability areas, with working familiarity across the rest. The role also covers the engineering that makes these capabilities trustworthy in business use. This includes evaluation and regression testing, human\-in\-the\-loop and other AI\-specific security controls, and accountability for inference cost and latency. The role builds on the shared platform services and reference implementations set by the Principal AI Engineer, within the target\-state architecture set by the Data/AI Platform Architect. It also takes handover of capabilities built by technical delivery partners and maintains them in production. **Role Responsibilities:** * Design, build, operate, and own end\-to\-end AI capabilities within a product or across multiple products, spanning retrieval and context assembly; model and agentic logic; integration with source systems and consuming applications (APIs, MCPs, authentication); monitoring and evaluation; and operational runbook maintenance * Train and evaluate machine learning models for well\-scoped problems such as classification, regression, anomaly detection, clustering, and forecasting, using operational and commercial data. Determine when and how to use ML models versus simpler statistical baselines * Build retrieval and context pipelines against enterprise content using chunking, tagging, and a metadata strategy. Measure and report retrieval quality against a defined standard * Design and maintain evaluation for these capabilities, including offline evals, automated scoring such as LLM\-as\-judge, and regression tests that run on every prompt or pipeline change to ensure quality before release. Monitor quality and drift signals in production * Own inference cost and latency in production, tracking cost per transaction and end\-to\-end response time, and profiling where that time is spent. Make tradeoffs where needed to stay within agreed targets * Implement human\-in\-the\-loop and AI\-specific security controls, including shadow and assisted modes, confidence and citation surfaces, override capture, audit trails, identity\-scoped retrieval, input and output guardrails, tool permissions, and prompt injection resistance * Take handover of application components built by technical delivery partners: read the code, close operational gaps, update the runbook, and maintain them in production * Improve team efficiency by establishing reusable components and reference examples, reviewing code, and onboarding new engineers **Job Requirements and Experiences:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, another STEM field, or a related discipline required * Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in software or AI/ML engineering roles, including demonstrated ownership of AI or ML capabilities end to end, from design through operation in a production environment * Depth in two or three of the capability areas listed under Basic Function, with working familiarity across the rest * Production experience with Python and SQL, a major cloud platform, version control and code review, containerized deployment, and CI/CD for AI products and services * Hands\-on experience with current orchestration, agent, and retrieval frameworks * Practical experience developing ML models for supervised and unsupervised problems * Experience building and maintaining evaluation and regression testing for AI and ML systems * Working knowledge of AI\-specific security and responsible AI controls * Competent use of coding agents and other AI\-assisted tooling, including scoping the right tasks for them, reviewing generated code, and recognizing which tasks are a poor fit for delegation * Experience with IT/OT environments, industrial data sources, or operational technology systems is preferred * Experience in the power, utilities, or clean energy sector, including knowledge of U.S. power markets, renewable project development, and clean energy technologies, is preferred **Work Envuironment** This position is an office\-based role with some travel and visits to other RWE Americas offices and field locations. The employee must be able to sit, walk, or stand for long durations of time *Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. RWE Americas is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.* **Pay range:** The annual base salary range for this position in Illinois is $127,000 \- $171,000\. The listed salary range represents our good faith estimate for this position and represents the range for new hire salaries across all U.S locations. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. RWE considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s education \& work experience, training \& certifications, and key skills as well as market and business considerations at the time of the offer. **Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, EAP, Education Assistance, Parental Leave, Paid time off, and Holidays. Eligible employees also participate in short\-term incentives, in addition to salary. **Apply with just a few clicks:** ad code **93593** Any questions? **Contact HR:** rwe\_americas\_recruiting@rwe.com We look forward to meeting you. Of course, you can find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Xing, too. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. RWE Americas, a subsidiary of RWE, is a US\-based energy company that is helping to meet the growing demand for energy across the United States. Backed by RWE’s 125\-year global legacy of managing diverse power assets, RWE Americas operates approximately 13 GW of power projects across 27 states. With a talented workforce of 2,000 employees, RWE Americas develops, constructs and operates wind, solar and battery storage projects, along with natural gas\-powered generation, that safely deliver affordable, reliable electricity to our customers. Committed to responsible development, RWE Americas invests in local and rural communities, creating jobs and partnering with stakeholders to support and strengthen the places where we live and work. Learn more about how RWE Americas is generating impact at americas.rwe.com. At RWE Americas, we foster a culture defined by our Essential Behaviors \- Have Courage, Create Impact and Actively Collaborate. We encourage bold thinking and continuous learning, and we value ownership, resilience and inclusion in everything we do. When you join us, you become part of a team that supports your development, respects your contributions and celebrates shared success. This is a place where you can grow your career and make a meaningful difference.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Build resilient systems. Strengthen security. Connect global operations. Serve as the senior technical resource for RefrigiWear's IT infrastructure, designing and protecting the systems, networks, and integrations that support our business across North America and Europe. The Opportunity RefrigiWear is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to design, build, secure, and maintain the technology foundation our global operations depend on. This is a senior, hands\-on technical role: you will guide infrastructure and security decisions, lead incident and recovery efforts, deliver complex integrations and automation, and serve as the escalation point for the IT support team. Working closely with the IT Operations Manager, you will balance long\-term technical direction and project delivery with the operational support needed to keep systems reliable, secure, and responsive. What You'll Own * Enterprise integrations \- Design, build, and support integrations among ERP, warehouse management, EDI, e\-commerce, HR, and Microsoft 365 systems, including automated employee onboarding and offboarding. * Infrastructure engineering \- Administer and maintain servers, virtualization, storage, and Microsoft Azure services. * Network operations \- Administer routing, switching, wireless, and firewall infrastructure and resolve complex connectivity issues. * Security operations \- Implement controls aligned with frameworks such as NIST CSF and ISO 27001\. * Incident leadership \- Manage vulnerability remediation, security monitoring, and alert response, and serve as the technical lead during security incidents. * Business continuity \- Maintain backup, replication, and disaster recovery systems and regularly test restores and failover capabilities. How You'll Make an Impact * Develop scripts and automations that reduce manual work and improve system reliability. * Administer user access controls and support periodic access reviews. * Evaluate and apply new tools, including AI\-based solutions, to improve efficiency. * Support system upgrades, migrations, and consolidation projects. * Serve as the escalation point for complex systems, network, application, and security issues. * Document solutions to recurring issues and communicate technical information clearly to non\-technical audiences. * Collaborate effectively with colleagues and vendors across multiple time zones. What Success Looks Like * Core infrastructure remains secure, reliable, scalable, and well documented. * Business systems exchange data accurately through stable, supportable integrations. * Security risks, vulnerabilities, and alerts are addressed with clear ownership and urgency. * Backup and disaster recovery capabilities are routinely tested and ready when needed. * Automation and thoughtful tooling reduce repetitive work and improve operational efficiency. * Complex issues are resolved with both immediate needs and the broader technical environment in view. What You Bring * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * At least seven years of experience in systems engineering, systems administration, or a similar technical role. * Experience designing and supporting integrations between business systems. * Proficiency in scripting or programming with PowerShell, Python, or SQL. * Hands\-on network administration experience, including routing, switching, and firewalls. * Required information security experience; CISSP or a similar certification is a plus. * Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity practices. * Experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, Odoo, or NetSuite is a plus. * Strong troubleshooting, prioritization, communication, and time\-management skills. * A security\-focused approach and the judgment to address tactical issues without losing sight of the larger environment. Work Environment This position operates primarily in an office environment with regular visits to warehouse and equipment\-room areas. Occasional international travel and after\-hours work may be required for scheduled maintenance and system incidents. Why RefrigiWear RefrigiWear is the industry's leading manufacturer of insulated industrial workwear, accessories, and personal protective equipment for subzero temperatures, inclement weather, and low\-visibility environments. This role provides the opportunity to shape the secure technology foundation behind a growing, international business. * Own meaningful infrastructure, security, integration, and recovery initiatives. * Influence technical direction while remaining close to hands\-on engineering work. * Support teams and business systems across North America and Europe. * Evaluate emerging tools and automation opportunities that improve how the organization operates. READY TO ENGINEER WHAT COMES NEXT? Bring your infrastructure expertise, security mindset, and systems perspective to RefrigiWear. RefrigiWear provides equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - AI Surfaces
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** WHO WE ARE Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI\-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high\-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work. WHAT WE DO Gavel is a Microsoft Word\-native agentic surface where lawyers perform real\-time, evidence\-based document editing and drafting. Gavel operates as a small, founder\-led team within Relativity, connecting its product and engineering work with Relativity teams responsible for shared platform capabilities, identity, and security. ***Job Description and Requirements*** ABOUT THE ROLE As a Lead Software Engineer, you will be the full\-stack technical owner for a major area of Gavel’s product, such as a family of agents or a core capability including the context pipeline, evaluation platform, or Word integration. You will own the technical plan across the front end, harness, and data layer, along with the quality of releases and the growth of the two to four engineers building the area with you. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. Roughly half of your time will be spent coding. You will work directly with Gavel’s CTO and Staff Engineer on architecture and represent your area to the broader Relativity technology team when it intersects with shared platform, identity, or security. The role reports to Pierre Martin, CTO of Gavel and VP of Engineering at Relativity, and may be based remotely in the United States or in Seattle or Chicago. WHAT YOU’LL DO * Own the technical roadmap and delivery for your area, from design through production monitoring. Break ambiguous product goals into shippable milestones and sequence them across the stack. * Design and build agents and the infrastructure they run on, including tool definitions, prompts and context assembly, structured outputs, guardrails, evaluation sets, and the Word and web experiences that surface them. * Run the evaluation and release loop for your agents. Understand acceptance rates, identify why results change, and determine whether a change is ready to ship. * Model a modern software development lifecycle for your squad through small, frequent commits, feature\-flagged production deployments, fast rollbacks, and daily use of agentic engineering tools to improve quality and velocity. * Partner directly with Dorna Moini, Pierre Martin, product, and design on what to build next, and engage with customers when the answer is not clear from the data. * Lead design reviews, establish coding and testing standards for your squad, mentor Senior and Advanced engineers, and participate in hiring. * Work with Relativity platform and security teams on areas that touch shared infrastructure, identity, or compliance. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Required * 8\+ years of experience building production software in service\-oriented, continuously deployed teams, including at least 1 year shipping LLM\-based products or features to real users. * Direct experience building full\-stack web applications and agentic applications, including ownership of at least one agentic capability in production involving tool use and function calling, multi\-step orchestration, structured outputs, retries and failure handling, and observation and debugging of non\-deterministic systems. * Practical experience with evaluation, including building evaluation sets, selecting metrics, using LLM\-as\-judge appropriately, and connecting offline results to online outcomes. * A solid grasp of retrieval and context engineering, including embeddings, hybrid search, chunking and ranking strategies, and context budgeting. * Hands\-on cloud infrastructure experience with AWS or Azure, or the willingness to develop deep expertise quickly, along with comfort using containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and production observability. * Fluency in at least one of TypeScript or Python and the ability to work across the stack, including React front ends, Node or Python services, and PostgreSQL. * Experience leading the technical work of a small team through planning, reviewing, unblocking, and developing engineers while continuing to deliver meaningful code. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain model\-quality regressions to lawyers and scoping trade\-offs to founders. * A strong drive for simplicity and the judgment to distinguish useful abstractions from unnecessary ones. WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT Impactful Mission * Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high\-stakes legal matters. Engineering at Scale * Work on distributed, cloud\-native systems that process large volumes of data. Cutting\-Edge Technology * Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech. Growth and Ownership * Gain experience owning systems end\-to\-end across cloud and distributed environments. Collaborative Culture * Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. Inclusive Environment * Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes. Compensation and Benefits * Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $150,000 and $224,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Documentations, Innovation, Leadership, Problem Solving, Process Improvements, Project Management, Quality Assurance (QA), Risk Management, Technical Knowledge, Troubleshooting

Use them to guide decisions and instrument production to measure acceptance, latency, and cost per agent. * Contribute to shared infrastructure, including the harness, context and retrieval pipeline, model routing, and observability stack. * Practice a modern software development lifecycle through small, frequent commits, feature\-flagged production deployments, fast rollbacks, and daily use of agentic engineering tools. * Debug non\-deterministic failures, retrieval misses, tool\-call errors, and model regressions. * Participate in design reviews, write clear technical documentation, review code for other engineers, and mentor Advanced engineers. * Work directly with product, design, and, at times, customers to understand what good work product means for a given legal task. **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** **Required** * 5\+ years of experience building production software in service\-oriented, continuously deployed teams, including experience shipping LLM\-powered features to real users through a launched project, not only experiments. * Direct experience building full\-stack web applications and agentic applications, including API usage across providers, function calling and structured outputs, prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and evaluation fundamentals. * Hands\-on cloud service development experience with AWS, Azure, or an equivalent platform, including containers, CI/CD, and production debugging, with a willingness to develop deep expertise . * Fluency in TypeScript or Python and the ability to work across a React frontend, Node or Python services, and PostgreSQL. * Experience writing and maintaining tests that catch regressions. * Strong engineering fundamentals in API design, data modeling, concurrency, performance, and reliability. * Good written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical decisions succinctly to non\-engineers. * A strong commitment to simplicity, demonstrated through open\-source work, side projects, or past professional work. **WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT** **Impactful Mission** * Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high\-stakes legal matters. **Engineering at Scale** * Work on distributed, cloud\-native systems that process large volumes of data. **Cutting\-Edge** **Technology** * Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech. **Growth and Ownership** * Gain experience owning systems end\-to\-end across cloud and distributed environments. **Collaborative Culture** * Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. **Inclusive Environment** * Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes. **Compensation and Benefits** * Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program . **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $126,000 and $190,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Computer Vision
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description ### **Position Summary:** Rockwell Automation is building FT Analytics VisionAI, a machine vision and visual inspection into the Portfolio. You will be the senior technical authority for the vision models behind that capability \- the detection, classification, and anomaly models that decide whether a part passes or fails on a line running at production rate, on hardware sitting next to a Logix controller. This is a hands\-on role. You will set the modeling direction, own the evaluation methodology that says whether a model is good enough to ship, and work directly with manufacturing customers on what their defects actually look like. Accuracy targets here are set by a customer's scrap rate and cycle time, not by a benchmark leaderboard. You will build in an AI\-first engineering environment \- coding agents running inside a harness we own, evals gating AI\-generated changes, GitHub Copilot Enterprise and Claude in the daily loop, and MCP\-based tooling that lets agents reach real build, test, and telemetry systems under human\-in\-the\-loop review. You will also help define what eval\-driven development means for model code specifically, where the regression suite gates a model release the way a test suite gates a build. This role will have a remote schedule and will report to the Director, Software Engineering. ### **Your Responsibilities:** * Own the modeling approach for visual inspection \- architecture selection, training strategy, and the accuracy, latency, and false\-reject targets each deployed model must hit. * Define and maintain the evaluation methodology and regression suite that gates a model release, including how labeled data is versioned, sampled, and audited. * Optimize models for constrained edge targets: quantization, runtime selection, and throughput tuning against real camera and controller timing budgets. * Own drift detection, retraining triggers, and production model monitoring across deployed customer installations. * Partner with customers and application engineers on feasibility, data collection strategy, and acceptance criteria for new inspection applications. * Set the technical bar for the ML discipline through design review, mentoring, and written architecture guidance. * Apply agents and evals to the ML workflow itself \- dataset triage, failure\-mode summarization, experiment scaffolding \- and measure whether they actually improved cycle time. ### **The Essentials \- You Will Have:** * Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience. * Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. ### **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have:** * Typically requires 8\+ years of related experience in a software product development environment. * Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical discipline. * Experience taking machine learning models from research through to production deployment * Experience with deep learning for computer vision \- detection, classification, segmentation, or anomaly detection * Experience deploying vision models to edge or embedded targets under fixed latency budgets. * Depth in PyTorch or TensorFlow, and in the tooling around dataset versioning, labeling quality, and experiment tracking. * Experience with model optimization techniques \- quantization, pruning, distillation, TensorRT or ONNX Runtime. * Direct customer\-facing technical experience: scoping applications, setting acceptance criteria, and defending a model's limits. * Exposure to industrial or manufacturing environments, machine vision hardware, or PLC\-based control systems. * Experience building evaluation harnesses that let a team ship model changes with confidence. ### **What We Offer:** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision * 401k * Paid Time off * Parental and Caregiver Leave * Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life. * To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com. This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation. For this role, the Base Salary Compensation is from $146,880\.00 \- 220,320\.00 USD with an annual target bonus of 8% of base salary. Our company benefits for the US can be found here . Actual pay will be based on factors such as skills, knowledge, education, and experience. *At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.* \#LI\-MG4 \#LifeAtRok We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at \+1 (844\) 404\-7247\.

illumination software * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks, changing priorities as necessary * Ability to work to meet deadlines and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude * Effective oral and written communication skills as required for the position * Ability to be self\-motivated, proactive, and an effective team player * Ability to interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others **TRAVEL:** ----------- * Up to 25% (Does not include local field visits) **WORKING CONDITIONS:** ----------------------- * General work environment \- sitting for long periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **Mission of the Role** ----------------------- **This position will be located at our Bloomington, MN or Canton, MA office.** The Software Engineer II plays a key role in designing, developing, testing, and supporting software solutions across the full lifecycle of SICK products and platforms. Operating with increased independence, this role drives technical execution across development projects, enhances software performance and reliability, and contributes to the advancement of SICK’s software ecosystem. The Software Engineer II collaborates closely with global, cross‑functional teams and supports strategic technology initiatives \- delivering high‑quality, scalable, and secure solutions aligned with SICK’s technology vision. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Software Development** * Independently execute software design, development, and implementation tasks following SICK’s development processes, including compliance with design control, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. * Lead enhancements, maintenance, and release activities across the software lifecycle, including major and minor versions, patches, updates, and long\-term support. * Develop prototypes, proofs of concept, and MVPs to validate new ideas and de‑risk project uncertainties. * Collaborate with internal and external development partners to meet technical, cost, and schedule expectations. * Provide technical input during requirements refinement and architectural discussions. **Testing \& Quality Assurance** * Plan, design, and execute comprehensive test procedures to validate functionality, performance, reliability, and security. * Conduct and sometimes lead code reviews, ensuring adherence to best practices, coding guidelines, and secure development standards. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex software issues, proposing short‑term fixes and long‑term systemic improvements. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Quality teams to translate technical requirements into actionable development tasks. * Contribute to backlog refinement, estimation, and risk identification during project planning. * Communicate technical decisions, project updates, and risk mitigation strategies clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders. **Documentation \& Reporting** * Create, maintain, and review technical documentation including design specifications, test plans, change logs, and release notes. * Support software change management and release documentation processes. **Continuous Improvement \& Learning** * Proactively maintain expertise in SICK platforms, technologies, and development tools. * Evaluate and introduce new technologies, frameworks, and development practices that support innovation and efficiency. * Mentor Software Engineer I team members through informal coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. * Contribute to process and product improvement initiatives. **Machine Vision, Algorithms \& Emerging Technologies** * Design, implement, and optimize classical and machine‑learning‑based algorithms for detection, inspection, automation, classification, tracking, and prediction using SICK 2D/3D cameras and programmable devices. * Employ advanced techniques—such as deep learning—to enhance system accuracy, robustness, and scalability. * Partner with internal teams to evaluate machine vision use cases and develop high‑value solutions. * Maintain knowledge of modern hardware technologies, vision software frameworks, and AI/ML toolchains. * Perform full engineering responsibilities including estimation, requirement analysis, technical risk assessment, and solution design. Perform other duties as may be assigned or required by management. **Key Qualifications** ---------------------- * **Experience**: 2\+ years of software development experience. * **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience is required. * **Position\-specific Qualifications**: + Strong problem‑solving, debugging, algorithmic thinking, and system design abilities. + Solid understanding of data structures, design patterns, and modern software engineering principles. + Proficiency in programming languages such as C\+\+, Python, or Lua, with the ability to work across multiple languages as needed. + Demonstrated experience with multithreading, multiprocessing, inter‑process communication, networking, or distributed systems. + Experience with version control (Git), code review workflows, CI/CD, and issue\-tracking systems. + Familiarity with web fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, REST/JSON, HTTP) and ability to develop simple UI tools or prototypes. + Ability to evaluate, integrate, and optimize third‑party or open\-source software components. + Experience monitoring, optimizing, and improving system performance and stability. + Experience designing or deploying machine vision / computer vision systems, including image processing or AI/ML\-based methods. + Exposure to training or operationalizing deep learning models. + Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code. + Strong communication skills with the ability to share technical information effectively across teams. * **Language**: Professional written and spoken fluency in English required. * **Schedule**: Generally Monday to Friday, full time; be on\-call on some weekends (if required). * **General Working Conditions**: Be able to usually work in an office environment; flexible (hybrid) work arrangements available. * **Travel**: Be able to travel up to 5% of the time, including internationally; must have a valid passport. * **Work Status**: Legally permitted to work in the country you are applying and willing to undergo an employment background check. **Compensation** ---------------- The base salary is one part of our Total Rewards package and is determined within a range. The starting base salary range for this position is listed below; the actual starting salary will be based on a variety of factors including experience, skill set, education, performance, licenses/certifications, business needs and other job\-related factors, as permitted by law. * **Starting Base Annual Salary Range**: $79,020 \- $119,515 * **Bonus Eligibility**: This role is not eligible for an annual bonus.

jobs.title: Manager, DevOps
jobs.description: Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source\-to\-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems. Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest\-to\-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community. For more information, visit www.supplier.io. **The Opportunity** The Manager, DevOps is a hands\-on leader who sets direction, builds durable processes, and develops the team that keeps our cloud platforms reliable, secure, and cost\-efficient. You will manage and grow the team while staying close to the technology, and you will be measured on the systems you put in place: how we plan, how we release, how we observe our environments, and how the team executes. The ideal candidate has built high\-functioning DevOps practices before and knows how to bring structure and accountability to a team without slowing it down. **What You Will Do*** Own the DevOps roadmap and delivery commitments across all Supplier.io environments, serving as the single point of accountability for DevOps direction and priorities. * Manage, coach, and develop the DevOps team and own hiring for the team as it grows, including defining roles, interviewing, and onboarding. * Establish and enforce core operational processes, including change management, release management, environment promotion standards, incident response and postmortems, on\-call coverage, and documentation and runbook standards. * Bring legacy, undocumented infrastructure under version control and documentation, and own disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including defined recovery time and recovery point objectives for our critical systems. * Bring planning discipline to the function, including sprint planning, estimation, and clear delivery commitments. * Define and drive the observability strategy, delivering centralized visibility across all environments with clear standards for monitoring, logging, alerting, and APM, and owning the related tooling decisions. * Own the cloud cost optimization program, including committed\-use discounts, right\-sizing of compute and databases, and reduction of logging and storage costs. * Drive security and compliance hygiene in partnership with the security function, including least\-privilege access, access reviews, key rotation, certificate automation, and vulnerability remediation. * Stay hands\-on: build and review CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and Kubernetes workloads alongside the team, and lead by example on technical standards. * Partner directly with Data Engineering to own the infrastructure and tooling that keeps their pipelines running: Snowflake account and warehouse administration, Airflow orchestration infrastructure, and secrets and connection management for data pipelines. * Coordinate with the STAC on infrastructure decisions, such as cloud architecture, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tooling, that affect the broader platform, so infrastructure choices stay aligned with company\-wide architecture standards. * Participate in the on\-call rotation alongside the team, especially early on, to stay close to the systems and set the standard for response quality. * Build a culture of automation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the DevOps team and the broader engineering organization. * Partner with software development, data engineering, AI, and platform teams to keep environments consistent and delivery fast, safe, and reliable. * Evaluate emerging tools and practices, and make pragmatic decisions about what to build, buy, and adopt. **What You will Need to Succeed:** * 10\+ years in DevOps, cloud engineering, or infrastructure roles with progressive responsibility, including 3\+ years leading or managing engineers with hiring, coaching, and performance responsibility. * A track record of building processes that stick: change and release jobs.title: Research Programmer III- Machine Learning & Computational Neuroscience, Kennedy Lab
jobs.description: **POSITION TITLE:**Research Programmer III (Software Engineer) **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Kennedy laboratory is involved in numerous projects to track, quantify, and forecast individual and group behavior and relate it to recorded neural activity. We develop new computational methods to understand how agents (animals, humans, virtual) gather information about their sensory environment, integrate this with internal motivational needs, and execute goal\-directed actions in complex, naturalistic environments. We also develop machine learning and computer vision platforms for high\-throughput animal phenotyping, with the goal of accelerating drug screening and repurposing efforts at Scripps. We seek motivated individuals interested in gaining hands\-on experience in scientific research projects, with a goal of contributing to scientific papers and participating in an active lab environment. You will also have the opportunity to lead independent research projects on existing datasets from our collaborators (U Penn, UCLA, Harvard, U Utah, Northwestern, and others). This is an ideal position for applicants interested in building their scientific CV ahead of applying to graduate programs in Computational Neuroscience or Machine Learning, or those looking for a longer term position where they can contribute to original scientific research and model development. **REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Math, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training and/or experience. Other STEM degrees may be accepted if accompanied with programming education, training, and/or experience. * Minimum of four years experience in software application development or research programming. * Experience with software development in Python. * Experience building and training deep neural networks for supervised, unsupervised, or reinforcement learning problems. * A demonstrated ability to apply the fundamentals of software application development. * Experience with version control, including git and github. **Please include code samples and/or a link to a public code repository with examples of your work.** **PREFERRED SKILLSET:** Prior experience with the one or more of the following is preferred: * Experience with sequence/time series data, control/reinforcement learning problems and environments, time series forecasting. * An understanding of generative modeling (hidden Markov models, diffusion models, etc). * Familiarity with topics in motor control, robotics, and neuroscience. As a member of a computational lab working in team projects, the following general skills are also preferred: * Experience developing scalable system architectures that adhere to good software engineering principles. * Ability to tackle large, open\-ended research questions independently and as part of a team. * Willingness to be an active participant in a computational lab environment, including taking part in lab meetings, journal clubs, and hackathons. * Experience working within a diverse, interdisciplinary team. * Experience contributing to open source software projects. **LOCATION:** La Jolla, California. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS****:** This position works in an office environment, and it is expected that work will be primarily performed in\-person. **COMPENSTAION:** The expected hiring range for this position is $75,000 to $100,000 per year, commensurate with experience. **COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS INCLUDE:** * Employer Contributed Retirement Plan – Depending on eligibility, employees receive an employer contributed retirement plan (no employee contribution required) and the option to contribute to a 403(b) (which is similar to a 401(k) using your own pre or post\-tax dollars) * Full Suite of Health and Welfare plans including three medical plan options (including an HSA available option), dental, vision, life insurance, disability, EAP and more * Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (Medical/Dependent Care) * Competitive vacation and sick leave policies * Free, on\-site parking *The above statements describe the level of work performed and expected in general terms. jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sempulse** Sempulse makes an FDA\-cleared, non\-invasive vital signs monitor called Halo that streams real\-time patient data to first responders and clinicians. It's validated by the U.S. Military, SOCOM, NATO, the Gates Foundation, and the Cleveland Clinic, among others, and it's been selected for the U.S. Army's Project Convergence. In December 2024, it saved its first life in the field. We're looking for a senior individual\-contributor role to help build the firmware that runs on Halo itself. **About the Work** This is primarily a firmware (software) development role. You'll contribute to the design, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of the low\-level code that runs on Halo, spanning key subsystems like power management, sensor integration, storage, memory management, and user I/O that provide core support for the algorithms and application communication. Engineers comfortable making light modifications to development boards to support prototyping and device updates will have an advantage here, occasionally serving as a supporting cast member to our manufacturing team when those needs come up. Halo is an FDA\-cleared device, which strongly influences our development and testing process. You'll work directly with our quality team to make sure V\&V and the right quality checkpoints are in place for all changes. We require rigorous testing and expect engineers to take responsibility for their work, including careful design, testing, and incorporating peer review from others. **What We're Looking For** * Professional experience building low\-level firmware for battery\-powered, Bluetooth\-connected devices. Medical device experience is ideal but not required. * Genuine depth with the SDK of one of the major SoC providers (e.g., Nordic, Silicon Labs, or STMicroelectronics), ideally across multiple SDK generations, with a credible story for picking up a new platform quickly. * Experience owning board bring\-up, toolchain migration, and porting existing drivers to new platforms, with specific examples you can speak to in detail. * Real, hands\-on driver development experience: you've written drivers against a datasheet, not just called into ones someone else wrote. * A strong sense of software architecture for embedded systems: you make deliberate calls about module boundaries and abstraction layers, and can defend those calls as the firmware grows. * You've written and debugged real production C yourself (not just through an AI agent), and you understand what your code is doing well enough to describe it clearly, in detail, to others. * Experience or strong interest in utilizing Rust in embedded applications. * Confident making light changes to board layout to support prototyping and device updates: reading schematics, bench work, and component\-level reasoning. Ideally you've studied electrical engineering or computer engineering, or have equivalent hands\-on industry experience. * Experience applying test automation at multiple levels: unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and comfort contributing to hardware\-in\-the\-loop automation, not just app\-level testing. * A real sense of ownership over the code you write. Your instinct should be to leave it better than you found it, including code that you didn't write. You know how to refactor with confidence. * Comfortable working within a regulated quality system: documentation, traceability, formal review. The strongest candidates will have hands\-on experience with V\&V and release processes in a regulated environment (medical device or similar). * Low ego, high confidence: you flag problems and propose better approaches without being asked. **How to Apply** Please submit a resume and brief cover letter explaining your experiences and how you're uniquely qualified for this role. **Location and Travel** Our engineering team is fully distributed, and we hire talent from anywhere. Travel is minimal, with occasional trips for in\-person working sessions, software demonstrations, or to support our manufacturing team when necessary. Candidates should expect periodic travel to Central Texas (Austin, San Antonio), California (San Diego), Pennsylvania, or Connecticut. *Note: No offshore resources or hiring agents.* Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Automation Genesis - Process Engineering Track
jobs.description: Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? **Transform the everyday with us!** Siemens Digital Industries Automation is a leader in industrial automation and digitalization. We deliver innovative solutions that help customers transform their manufacturing operations and build smarter, more connected factories. Our portfolio spans advanced automation controls and sensors, high\-performance drives and motors, HMI and SCADA systems, industrial process control and manufacturing execution systems, digital twin and simulation tools, along with equipment maintenance and safety systems. By integrating advancements in artificial intelligence, edge computing, IT/OT integration, and the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), our technology unlocks new levels of productivity, efficiency, and data\-driven insights. We are looking for rising and recent engineering graduates for our **Automation Genesis program – Process Engineering Track.** The first six months of this position will be based at **Mason, OH**, with subsequent placement at one of our DI Automation hubs or customer regions, including but not limited to **Alpharetta, GA; Elk Grove Village, IL; Chicago, IL; Harleysville, PA; Lebanon, OH; or Detroit, MI** based on business needs. This program, comprised of two phases, is designed to prepare you for impactful application engineering roles within Siemens Digital Industries Automation. The journey begins with a 6\-month intensive onboarding phase that combines structured training with hands\-on project work to develop your expertise in our Digital Industries Automation portfolio, accelerate your understanding of our business strategy and core processes, enhance your professional skills, and strengthen your engineering and project execution capabilities. Phase 2 is an immersive 12\-month, during which you’ll deepen your technical expertise in industrial process control, gain hands\-on experience with engineering and commissioning large\-scale systems, and refine customer engagement skills. Upon successful completion, you’ll transition to a designated full\-time role as an Application Engineer on one of our Process Automation Engineering teams. **You’ll** **make an impact by:** * Actively engaging in instructor\-led training, workshops, and engineering projects to build a strong understanding of Siemens and our DI Automation technology portfolio, while mastering the skills to design and deliver innovative and safe automation solutions for customers in process industries (such as chemical, food/beverage, and pharmaceutical) * Developing, implementing, and testing Distributed Control System applications and Manufacturing Execution Systems for greenfield facilities, facility expansions, and system modernization initiatives * Identifying and documenting system requirements using Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams(P\&IDs), process descriptions, and/or existing control logic * Creating test specifications, performing simulations, and executing software/hardware demos to validate compliance with customer requirements, and supporting system installation and onsite commissioning activities to ensure successful project delivery * Working closely with project managers, project teams and technical customers throughout the project lifecycle while supporting project proposals, providing technical calculations and engineering estimates, adhering to quality standards, schedule, and budget requirements, and contributing to customer satisfaction **You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:** **Basic Qualifications:** * Eligibility Requirement: This Development Program is designed for individuals beginning their professional careers. Candidates must have completed, or will complete, the required educational credentials prior to the program start date. This program is intended for candidates at an early career stage. Current students seeking an experiential learning opportunity while continuing their studies should consider our internship and co\-op programs. * Available to start full\-time employment on June 7, 2027 * Bachelor's degree: Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related majors * Foundational understanding of and interest in process controls, industrial automation, instrumentation, or other complex engineering systems through coursework, research, projects, internships, or other related experiences * Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies, engineering concepts, software platforms, and design tools * Experience with interpreting, documenting, or analyzing technical and customer requirements based on engineering documentation such as process flow diagrams (PFDs), P\&IDs, electrical schematics, control logic, or design specifications * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to apply engineering principles to develop, test, troubleshoot, and commission integrated engineering systems and applications involving hardware, software, controls, instrumentation, and other connected equipment * Demonstrated ownership and time\-management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and adapt to changing project needs * Strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to understand customer needs and provide consultation, and effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams in both industrial settings and office settings * Must be willing and able to commit to the required relocations: first to Mason, OH for 6 months, followed by assignment to one of our DI Automation hubs or customer region including (but not limited to) Alpharetta, GA; Elk Grove Village, IL; Chicago, IL; Harleysville, PA; Lebanon, OH; and Detroit, MI. Relocation assistance is provided to hires who must relocate more than 50 miles from their permanent address for each required move. * Travel requirements will be a function of assigned projects (including system installations and commissioning activities at customer sites) and will likely range from periods of light travel (5\-10%) to periods of higher travel (50%) * Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to PLCs, industrial networking, Distributed Control Systems (DCS), and/or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) * Previous internship, research, or project experience in an industrial, manufacturing, chemical processing, or project engineering environment * Programming or software experience with Python, SQL, C/C\+\+, and/or Visual Basic * Demonstrated leadership through academic or extracurricular activities **Redaction Notice:** As part of the application, you will be asked to confirm your academic enrollment status. If your application includes uploaded documents (resume, transcript, or other materials), you may redact any information identifying your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. Redacting this information will not affect your candidacy. **About Siemens:** We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource\-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here. **Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:** We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. \#LI\-DY1 \#URDP \#DIAearlycareers $81,000 $84,000

The Small engine business continues to evolve with ongoing multi\-million\-dollar R\&D programs that will ensure the product will be in service in fifty years’ time. With a solid history and an even brighter future I cannot imagine there has been a better time to join the great little team here in Indianapolis. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. post\-incident reviews and reliability improvements. * **Apply solid engineering practices** in your area, including clean code, robust testing, observability, security, and documentation, to keep our optimizations. * **Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and team knowledge sharing**, including mentoring interns or onboarding newer engineers. * **Contribute to shared platform tooling and patterns**, helping make it easier for Openflow teams to build, deploy, and operate high\-quality connectors and runtimes. ### **Our ideal Software Engineer will have:** * **2\+ years of industry experience** building and operating backend or platform services, including hands\-on work with distributed systems. * **Strong computer science fundamentals**, including algorithms, data structures, and systems design, with the ability to apply them pragmatically in production code. * **Practical experience with distributed systems concepts** such as concurrency, replication, partitioning, codebases. * **Experience building cloud\-native services on at least one major cloud provider**, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, using containers, CI/CD, and modern monitoring and logging stacks. * **A track record of delivering high\-quality, maintainable solutions** to non\-trivial engineering problems, balancing speed with long\-term reliability and simplicity. * **Strong collaboration and communication skills**, with the ability to work effectively with teammates across locations, give and receive feedback, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly. * **BS in Computer Science or a related field**, or equivalent practical experience building and shipping distributed systems. * Bonus: Experience with **data integration, observability, or streaming/flow technologies** such as jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Fullstack AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Why you should join us** -------------------------- At Solstice, we're building AI software that helps life sciences teams turn complex scientific and brand information into marketing content they can create, refine, and review with confidence. We've worked with leading life sciences manufacturers and more than 50 pharma brands. You'll build the systems and experiences that make this work faster and easier. * **Build the foundation for how people work with AI.** Your work will span the infrastructure that runs agents and the product experiences that help customers direct, inspect, and use their output. * **Take on engineering problems with depth.** Make long\-running agents reliable, stream progress into responsive interfaces, deliver the right context securely, and understand what happens across every step of execution. * **Have a direct hand in what we build.** Join an early team where you'll shape architecture, make product tradeoffs, and work closely with our co\-founders, Yiwen and Aris. You'll see your decisions reach customers and use their feedback to improve the product. We're backed by Transformation Capital, Twelve Below, Virtue, and the founders of Datavant, Commure, and Paradigm. **About the role** ------------------ We're looking for a Fullstack AI Engineer to build and maintain our agent platform and bring its capabilities into the product. You'll own work across backend services, APIs, agent orchestration, and customer\-facing interfaces, with a strong focus on Python and platform engineering. Python is our primary backend language, and FastAPI powers our APIs. You'll help decide how agents run, recover from failures, access tools and context, and communicate with the application. You'll also build the React and Next.js experiences that give users visibility and control over that work. You'll partner with product, design, Applied AI, and the broader engineering team to take problems from an initial idea through architecture, implementation, and production. The scope includes both building new capabilities and making the systems behind them easier to operate and extend. **What you'll be working on** ----------------------------- * **Build and maintain the agent platform.** Use Python, FastAPI, Restate, and Redis to build the shared systems that power our agents. Shape session management, orchestration, tool access, and context delivery so new AI capabilities can build on a dependable foundation. * **Design APIs that power the product.** Build Python and FastAPI services for content creation, document processing, collaboration, and enterprise integrations. Design clear API contracts and PostgreSQL data models that make complex workflows straightforward to build on. * **Solve the hard parts of agent execution.** Make long\-running workflows recover from failures, handle cancellation and retries, and run in isolated environments. Give agents current documents, assets, and brand context while keeping customer data and permissions properly scoped. * **Bring AI workflows to life in the product.** Build with React, Next.js, and TypeScript to show streaming progress and tool activity, support reconnectable sessions, and give users intuitive ways to review, accept, or refine AI output. * **Make the whole system observable.** Connect APIs, orchestration, and agent execution through Datadog and OpenTelemetry tracing, structured logs, metrics, and alerts. Build the visibility to explain failures, find bottlenecks, and improve latency, reliability, and cost. * **Make quality measurable.** Partner with Applied AI engineers on evaluations and regression checks, using tools such as Braintrust alongside API and integration tests. Turn production traces and customer feedback into better agent behavior and more dependable releases. * **Own the path from idea to production.** Work with product and customer teams to choose the right problems, make practical tradeoffs, and ship complete features. Deploy, monitor, and improve what you build as customers use it. **Some ideal traits we're looking for** --------------------------------------- * **5\+ years of software engineering experience.** You've built and shipped production software, with experience owning backend services or fullstack applications. * **Depth in Python and FastAPI.** You've shipped and operated production Python services. You can build well\-designed FastAPI APIs and understand asynchronous programming, validation, authentication, and error handling. * **Strong systems fundamentals.** You design clear service contracts and data models, work comfortably with PostgreSQL and Redis, and think through concurrency, transactions, idempotency, and failure recovery. * **Experience turning AI into useful software.** You've built AI applications or the infrastructure behind them. You can reason about tool calling, context management, agent sessions, and the boundaries between model behavior and application logic. * **The ability to deliver across the stack.** You're comfortable working in React, Next.js, and TypeScript and connecting an interface to backend APIs. You care about how the product feels, including usability, accessibility, and performance. * **A habit of making systems understandable.** You use traces, logs, and metrics to investigate production issues and build instrumentation that helps the next engineer diagnose them. Testing, security, and maintainability are part of how you ship. * **Ownership and good judgment.** You can turn an ambiguous problem into a practical plan, explain the tradeoffs, and follow through. You work closely with others, seek feedback, and care about whether your work solves the customer's problem. Experience with Restate or Temporal, sandboxed agent execution, streaming systems, or AI evaluation tools is a plus. You don't need experience with every tool in our stack. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly. Healthcare or pharma experience is welcome but not required. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Equity in an early\-stage company * Unlimited paid time off * 401(k) with a 4% employer match * Company\-provided office lunches five days a week * A stipend for professional development * Relocation assistance * Sponsorship for O\-1, H\-1B, and TN visas **Competitive NYC compensation** -------------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $200,000 to $300,000, plus equity. Compensation reflects your experience, seniority, and the scope of responsibility you take on. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

(STI), you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, integrity, and individual growth. Headquartered in Somerville, New Jersey, the company has grown to serve multiple markets and geographies and remains committed to innovation, safety, and performance in passive fire protection. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Rails
jobs.description: #### **About Us** We’re Bolt.new by StackBlitz! We’re the team that brought you WebContainers, the first\-of\-its\-kind technology that made it possible to run Node.js right inside your browser. That breakthrough kicked off our journey in 2019, and it’s what powers the blazing\-fast online IDE used by over 1 million developers every month. But we didn’t stop there. We doubled down on everything we learned and built **Bolt.new** — the fastest way to go from idea to production without writing traditional code. It’s a next\-gen, AI\-powered app builder that helps you create, edit, and deploy full\-stack web and mobile apps instantly, right in your browser. No installs. No setup. Just smart automation and instant dev environments that let you move at the speed of thought. We’re a fully remote team, globally distributed, deeply collaborative, and seriously passionate about building the future of software development. This is your chance to join a small team with a big vision. If you love shipping fast, solving real problems, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, we’d love to meet you. #### **✨ About This Opportunity** We’re looking for a Senior Ruby on Rails Engineerto help build the backend systems that power StackBlitz.com and Bolt.new. In this role, you’ll work on platform features, developer infrastructure, and integrations that enable millions of developers around the world to build software entirely in the browser. You’ll be part of a small, ambitious team focused on making software development more accessible to everyone. If you enjoy building robust systems, shipping high\-quality code, and collaborating across teams — this could be the role for you. #### **️ How You'll Contribute** * Improve the scalability, reliability, and performance of our Ruby on Rails application * Design and optimize data storage using PostgreSQL and object storage services * Build features for teams, organizations, and developer communities * Develop integrations with external platforms to extend our product ecosystem * Help review and shape code from peers to ensure quality, security, and best practices #### **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional experience with Ruby on Rails * 5\+ years of experience with PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases) * Experience with AWS and modern cloud infrastructure * Familiarity with CSS, SASS, HTML, and other templating/styling languages * Experience building web applications with REST or GraphQL APIs * Production experience with Node.js and TypeScript; this role works across both the Rails and Node/TypeScript stacks * Strong communication skills — especially when explaining technical topics * Strong verbal and written English communication skills are required, as this role involves frequent collaboration with team members, stakeholders, and customers where English is the primary working language. #### **Bonus Points** * Familiarity with Cloudflare Workers or edge infrastructure * Interest in working with AI or LLMs * Experience integrating with GitHub APIs or other version control systems #### **A Few Notes** * You do **not** need a college degree to apply * You do **not** need to be located in the U.S. — we’re remote\-friendly * You do **not** need to meet every qualification listed above. If this role excites you, we want to hear from you.
